records.title: The Spirit of Capitalism
records.description: Sayuri is a hard-working OL, the unsung heroine of Japan’s modern economy. With the help of her horny colleague Keiko and eager understudy Mayu-tan, the girls will lower office stress and keep spirits high...and make their way to another year of record profitability for the company!

records.title: Inran Kyonyuu Nakadashi Apaato
records.original_title: 淫乱巨乳中出しアパート
records.description: This manga has only one volume.

records.title: Sora no Mannaka
records.description: Amasawa Miyako, the middle child of 5 siblings, is the only 'normal' one, the others all being very good-looking and very talented at something. She takes care of them at home with cooking, cleaning, etc. because their parents are very busy at work, but she has to deal with both her own insecurities and people's opinions on how she's not like her brothers and sisters. It also doesn't help that she likes her best friend who's in love with her older sister.

records.title: Rakuen Route
records.description: One day, an angel fell from heaven. Along the way, she lost her wings. Now, she is banished from heaven until she can find them, and thus our story begins...

records.title: Alpen Rose
records.description: Lundi is a young boy who lives with his aunt and uncle in Switzerland in the early 1930s. One day while walking around the Alps, Lundi finds a little girl who is the only survivor of a plane crash and has lost all her memories. She is named Jeudi by his uncle and both of them are raised together. As they grow up together, Jeudi and Lundi develop a deep friendship for each other. A few years later Jeudi wants to find her past. Her only clue is a song that she is constantly hearing in her head, a song called Alpen Rose. At the time of World War II, Jeudi and Lundi set on a journey to discover Jeudi's past and in the process learn the depth of the love they have for each other.

records.title: TUDM
records.description: Two soldiers are struggling their way out through the thick jungle under heavy fire from the enemy.

records.title: Aisei, Shinku wo Daku
records.description: Iruka Sumoto wishes to surpass Birou Akutaya, a detective prodigy. A disappearance case catches the attention of Iruka and drags in Birou.

records.title: Pine Kiss
records.description:
In Pine Kiss, the graceful and endearing series by the celebrated Eunhye Lee, Orion is the beautiful and mysterious new teacher at school. He immediately catches the attention of Sebin, daughter of a rich gang leader. When Orion is involved in protecting her from gang rivalry, it becomes apparent that there is more to this teacher than just a pretty face. Not only are students surprised, but Orion's effect entangles the already troubled relationships of the different students. The passionate triangle between Orion and Sebin and another student, Dali, as well as the mysterious past of the beautiful teacher is realized in Lee's elegant drama.

(Source: Net Comics)

records.title: Jewelry Eyes
records.description:
Summary by Manga Abyss :

Runa has a special hypnotherapy power that she inherited from her parents, and with it she can repel perverts/molesters. However, due to this power she can’t find her first love, and it can’t help her fall in love. How will this power affect her crush, Kitagawa-kun?


There are 2 chapters for the original story. Then 2 side stories.

records.title: BOYS LOVE
records.description: Magazine editor Mamiya meets popular high school model Noeru Kisaragi for a story Mamiya’s working on. When Noeru suddenly tries to make a move by going down on him, Mamiya turns him down flat. But Mamiya’s loneliness starts to get to him and he decides to try starting over with Noeru on equal footing. Mamiya’s sincerity causes Noeru to open his heart as well, and before long the two begin to form a deep emotional connection, but…

records.title: Suki ni Naru Made Matte
records.original_title: 好きになるまで待って
records.description:
Whenever it was break time, Hikami-kun sat at my desk and talked with his friends. I was concerned about it, but since he is a hot guy I couldn’t say anything about it. On that fateful day, I dropped Hikami-kun’s cell in the fish tank, and now I have to be his slave?! (Source: Manga Abyss)

Also includes:
Uso to Koi no Hajimari - Tomoko's childhood friend "Ken-chan" comes to Tokyo and wants her to show him around. Tomoko can't be bothered, so she sends Akane to pretend to be her instead...

1/3 no Kareshi - When Rei visits the junior high section of the school, a mysterious guy takes an embarrassing picture of her and refuses to delete it unless she meets him again later...

Deatta Toki ni Boku wa Mouinai - Yoshii Shougo never talked to Ashizawa Yuu before he was in a fatal auto accident, but now his spirit can't move on without her help...

records.title: Love Wan!
records.description: This is a very cute story about a girl who adores dogs, and one day is given a magic wand to turn people into dogs.

records.title: Elevator wo Orite Massugu

records.description:
1. Elevator wo Orite Massugu
2. Rainy Day Children
3. Love Machine
4. The Sun Adventurers
5. Fly into the Blue Sky
6. Awful Boy

(Source: IvyScan)

records.description:
Just like the prequel (Flat 37c), this one's about the perverted relationship between teens. There's a good element of romance, with a bit of drama but this is a hentai so there's only so much that you can expect out of this manga.

1. (はじまりのはじまり)

6. (ホントウノキモチ)
7. (～♭37℃～)
8. (太陽の季節)

records.title: Toradora!
records.description:
The original light novel that inspired the hit manga and anime series!

Takasu Ryuuji might look like a thug, but he’s actually a nice guy. Making friends when you’ve got an unintentionally scary face is tough–and don’t even get him started on girlfriends. But with his secret crush in his class, the start of his second year of high school is off to a good start…until he crosses paths with Aisaka Taiga. Beautiful, frightening, and not quite five feet tall, the girl known as the Palmtop Tiger is the one person in school even scarier than Ryuuji himself–and he’s just made the mistake of making her very, very angry.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

records.title: Taiho Shite Miina!
records.description: Amari's goal has always to master the legendary Chinese cooking skill that enables you to feel the emotions of the chef. One day she is challenged by the neighboring resteraunt's cook, a boy her own age! Will she win...his heart? (Source: Esthetique)

records.title: Trouble Love Candy
records.description: The experienced Inspector Kazuhiko and the pre-graduate Michihisa are a loving homosexual couple. But Kazuhiko is always busy and seems to constantly find himself in trouble while Michihisa gets into just as much trouble himself! Frustrated with the little time they have together, Kazuhiko seeks help from Michihisa but the latter, not wanting to bother the already work-overloaded Kazuhiko, continually attempts to solve these problems on his own...

records.title: I.D.
records.description: The unsuspected newbie of the Police Investigation Division One, Detective Hinari was dispatched to deliver a sample to the forensic lab. There he encountered researcher, Yasoshima Shiro, who reminded Hinari of his first love, a gentle police captain. Immediately smitten at first sight, Yasoshima lured Hinari with a DNA lecture and preyed on the still innocent Hinari! As much as Hinari hated to admit it, he wasn't entirely unaffected by Yasoshima. Will Hinari be able to resist the quirky scientist!? A delicate yet comical love story!

records.title: Mondoumuyou!
records.description: Hitaka Touko catches a thief in her room. It turns out to be Hayashida Ichisaie, a classmate. Through a series of unexpected moments, she finds herself caught up in the act of burglarizing along with Ichisaie.

records.title: Armored Core - Tower City Blade
records.description: A short story based on the long running video game series of the same name.

records.title: Last Fantasy
records.description: Tian and Drei von Richenstein, two unlikely heroes, embark on an adventure filled with excitement, intrigue, and comic relief. Their adventures are complicated by the fact that they have a knack for making allies into new enemies... (Source: Tokyopop)

records.title: Library Wars: Spitfire!
records.description: The Japanese government passes the Media Improvement Act as law in the year 1989 which allows the censorship of any media deemed to be potentially harmful to Japanese society by deploying MIA agents with the mandate to go after individuals and organizations that are trying to exercise the act of conducting freedom of expression activities in the media. However, local governments opposed to the Media Improvement Act establishes armed anti-MIA defense force units to protect libraries from being raided by MIA agents under the Library Freedom Act. The conflict between MIA agents and library soldiers have went on to the year 2019.

records.title: Front Mission: Dog Life & Dog Style
records.original_title: フロントミッション ドッグ ライフ アンド ドッグ スタイル
records.description:
Huffman Island is a land split by an uneasy cease-fire between two major world powers, the USN (United States of the New Continent) and the OCU (Oceania Cooperative Union). The cease-fire has held for 20 years, but now tensions are mounting, and it looks like open war will break out again soon. Matsuda Akira has gone to join the on-site reporting team for NNTV. Are he and his colleagues really ready for the horrors they may face if they're caught in the middle of a war?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

records.title: Front Mission - The Drive
records.original_title: フロントミッション ～ザ ドライブ～
records.description:
One of Two Manga's Based on Square Enix's Strategy RPG Series

"Front Mission"

records.title: Subarashiki Kono Sekai
records.original_title: すばらしきこのせかい
records.description:
Neku Sakuraba, a 15 year-old boy with a hobby for music and graffiti, wakes up in what seems to be the Shibuya shopping district of Tokyo, Japan. With no idea why he's there, he opens his hand to realize he is holding a strange black pin. After flipping it with his hand, the thoughts of the people surrounding him began to flow into his head at once. Surprised, Neku discovers he is able to read the minds of others, and assumes it has something to do with the black pin he is holding.

A cellphone starts to ring in his pocket, and he can't tell whether it is his or not. A text message appears: "Reach 104. You have 60 minutes. Fail, and face erasure. -The Reapers". After discovering he can't delete the message, a timer of 60 minutes imprints onto his right hand. Neku is in Shibuya to play the "Reapers' Game", which spans a total of 7 days. All Players of the Reapers' Game have a black pin with a skull embedded on it.

(Source: Wikipedia)

records.title: Mama's Lover
records.description: A high school girl finds herself falling for her mother's much younger new boyfriend.

records.title: Miko to Yajuu
records.description: The Death Panda is a shock manga from by artist Waita Uziga about a giant demonic panda bear from hell.

records.title: Knife
records.original_title: 尾崎かおり短篇集　 ナイフ
records.description: Collection of short stories by Kaori Ozaki, including her debut story. The earliest story in the volume was written when she was sixteen, and the last one when she was nineteen.

records.title: SOIL
records.description: Something strange is going on in "Soil New Town." The sudden disappearance of a seemingly normal family leads the two detectives Yokoi and Onoda to the idyllic town in the middle of nowhere. What looks like a routine case at first quickly turns into a complex and deadly riddle where nothing is what it seems to be. Will the two disparate investigators manage to solve the mystery before it's too late?

records.title: Kareki ni Koi wo Sakasemasu
records.original_title: 枯れ気に恋を咲かせます
records.description:
From the mangaka of Aishiteruze Baby, collection of 4 short stories.

1. Kareki ni Koi wo Sakasemasu (枯れ気に恋を咲かせます)
Ritsu is a normal high schooler, whose people thoughts are always about how cold she is. One day, she met a weird looking guy by chance,... who turned to be the new transfer student... But for what reason is he there? And why is it that she cant help but care of him??

2. Heavy Crash!! (ヘヴィ クラッシュ!!)
Two girls who are always tagged as a problem child. Even though, they arent, still they dont care, their friend ship is the best. But... What if one of them falls over heels in love?

3. Juicy☆Game (ジューシー☆ゲーム)
After too much one-sided loves, Natsuko is finally reciprocated and got herself a boyfriend. But... not everything is pink and flowers, her thick-headed brother wont let this go easily...

4. Love Service! (ラブサービス！)
Miku is a girl with no interest in school, whose whereabouts are always out of it. Then, on the streets a guy suddenly saves her from being tossed by a car, but... breaks her phone?!! Who is this guy?!!

records.title: Tengai Retrogical
records.description:
The neighborhood known as Tengai-ya exists behind a fog of strange and spooky rumors, but when his flaky father agrees to become its property manager, high schooler Ryohei will uncover more than a few secrets! After breathing new life into its coldest, dustiest corners, this teenager will shed a little light upon its dark cloak of mysteries and the strange new friends he meets beyond the gates of Tengai-ya.

(Source: ADV)

records.title: Flag Fighter
records.description:
There is a game known as Flag Fight, a game where the player who captures 1,000 flags will control the world. Each fighter has pride in his own flag, and tries to capture the other's flag. A mighty flag fighter called Reppa Kagura uses Long (dragon) techniques to resist all the other strong fighters. One day, an old man gives him some solid advice: There is something important missing from Reppa's Long. When he hears this, Reppa decides to become this old man's disciple.

(Source: Anime News Network)

records.title: Hana Shinobu no Koi
records.description:
A boy, who always gets bullied is told by his dad that the day he turns sixteen he is going to get someone that will always be with him. The boy, Kazu-kun, believes it will be a fiancee, since his dad got a wife (his mom) and his grandma a husband (his grandpa) on their sixteen birthday, but oh surprise, it is a boy and he is a ninja. So begins the story between Kazu-kun and Masanaru and their romance.

4. Path To Happiness
Single father and jobless Yagami Chiharu is saved from being hit by a car by an old high school friend, Okumura Masakazu, but the latter gets injured. So Yagami becomes Okumura's housekeeper until he recovers from his injury.

5. Project Section 3: Only For Two
Yokohama Takashi became a toy maker chasing a childhood dream, but when his project gets the worst selling record, he is demoted in the third section, where all the employees end up quitting... Will Yokohama be able to revive the team with the support of the section manager?

6. Banquet For Two
Continuation to the previoous chapter. To celebrate the sales success Yokohama organizes a banquet...

records.title: Haou Taikei Ryuu Knight
records.original_title: 覇王大系リューナイト
records.description: The story of a young knight named Adeu. It fallows his adventures as he travels the world of Earth Tear.

records.title: Possession Tracer
records.description: Hizuka Kuon is a young woman who has a special power, giving her the power to possess people, and to see through their eyes.

records.title: Ryu Seiki
records.original_title: 竜世紀 ドラゴンセンチュリー
records.description: Long ago, in a world of shadows, the sky was split by a bolt of lightning; according to legend, from this bolt was born a warrior who was the reincarnation of the Dragon God...

records.title: Kanon: Another Story - WONDERTHREE
records.original_title: Kanon アナザーストーリー WONDERTHREE
records.description: An alternate retelling of KEY’s classic work, Kanon, where it asks: what if Yuuichi DIDN’T lose all his memories of 7 years before? And what if he was really sarcastic? Do NOT read if you don’t know the original story behind Kanon.

records.title: Airin Dream
records.description: Reimi is your poor middle school girl who yerned to meet a rich guy and marry off rich. Meet Airin, a strange girl who so happens to be rich, but dosn't even look or act like it! Watch as Reimi and Airin turn each other's world upside down! Welcome to a world filled with cuteness, craziness, and comedy!

records.title: Metro Survive
records.description: Mishima is your average spineless pushover, working as a repairman for the Exopolis Tower, Tokyo's largest and hottest highrise business and entertainment building. He promised to come home in time to celebrate his son's birthday, but when he lets his pushy boss saddle him with overtime, the task takes him all night. On the morning subway train heading home, a massive earthquake strikes and collapses both the Exopolis Tower and its underground train lines. Now Mishima is trapped deep underground with the other passengers of the train, some of whom are less than cooperative. Will he be able to take the initiative for once and lead them all to freedom, or will they starve in their underground prison?

records.title: Kin Gin Kokoro
records.description: Each birthstone holds a different significance. Silver birthstones represent bad luck and are shunned by all, while gold birthstones are the exact opposite. Saffron is the holder of a gold birthstone, while Kai is the holder of a silver one. How will these two cousins get through such a twisted fate in such a traditional society?

records.title: A Girl in a Million
records.description:
A vacation fling was completely out of character for old-fashioned Carol, but her attraction to intriguing, older Marius tempted her to break her own rules. The next thing she knew, though, he'd turned up working at her hospital! Does she have what it takes to attract-much less keep the attentions of-this intimidating, sophisticated, and utterly compelling man?

(Source: Dark Horse)

records.title: For Someone
records.description: A one-shot about a boy who will do anything to impress a girl that he likes. What he wants is a kiss from her, but will he get one?

records.title: Under the Air
records.description:
From science fiction, historical fiction, to contemporary drama, Under the Air includes a variety of tales that depict the duality of man—good and evil; loving and violent.

An injured white-supremacist struggles with the fact that he was brought back to life by a black organ donor; a young man in the wild west seeks revenge for his father’s murder; an escaped convict holds a family hostage in a cave that causes hallucinations; the only two survivors of a nuclear apocalypse dare to explore the outside world—Tezuka’s characters are put to the test when the delicate balance of their minds are disrupted, discovering something dark hidden deep within themselves. Don’t miss this uncommon, unheard, unusual, out-of-the-ordinary collection of short stories by the late, great Osamu Tezuka.

(Source: DMP)

records.title: Maken-Ki!
records.description:
Takeru Ooyama, a young normal yet perverted minded guy, got accepted and now goes to a school that, unknown to him, was where combat and magic is used. On the first day, he meets again after three years: Haruko Amaya, his childhood friend, Inaho Kushiya, a girl who says she's his fiance, and Kodama Himegami, a blonde who wants to kill him. Finding out that there are many girls there that just don't like him, he is told that everyone there uses a special magic ability while using an item or weapon called a Maken. Later, he finds that no Maken is acceptable for him and doesn't know what to do, since in this school the students get into duels that showcase their magic and combat power, to which he seemingly has none.

Notes:
- Chapter 39 is divided into two parts.
- Chapter count includes 15 extras, the side story "Maken-Ki! Kai!!", and one-shots "Kanojo wa Muma de Irregular", "Gakuen Dragon Slayer" and "Ezaki-senpai, Komarimasu".

records.title: Chika * Chika Cheap ★ Star
records.original_title: チカ＊チカチープ★スター
records.description: Side stories and gags featuring Usagi/Misaki and Nowaki/Hiroki. Also contains short (novel) stories in the Junai universe.

records.title: Juusha to Oresama
records.description:
1-4)Being the willful, extravagant 3rd prince, Philnaldo frequently graces the cover of tabloids with his scandalous affairs with women. This annoys his personal attendant, Ralph, to no end! Then Philnaldo propositioned him unexpectedly; in exchange for dropping all his women, Ralph would take their place… in his bed! A royal love story of a prince and his servant, where both refuse to face the true feelings of their hearts… but what happens when a crisis occurs!?

5) The Garden in the Past- Ichika is in elementary school when his father dies. His mother takes him to live with Yuu, a mysterious young man who has a connection to Ichika's father. As his mother becomes more unstable, Ichika grows more dependent on Yuu...

6)Darling 2002- Nishihara is odd-ball president of the puppet club, (yes, that's right, puppet club) and desperate to keep it from being shut down. What he needs is a new member but grabbing the person next to you isn't a good idea when you're standing by Moriya Koyo, the scariest guy in school. Moriya tells Nishihara off, but entranced by his beautiful voice, Nishihara becomes determined to win Moriya over to the puppet club! Stalking, badgering, and chasing, nothing is off limits for Nishihara.

(Source: Fantasy Shrine)

records.title: Wasurene no Language
records.original_title: 忘れ鳴のランガージュ
records.description: Futaba, whose father is an oceanographer, has transferred schools 8 times because of his work. Afraid of eventually being forgotten, she tries not to make any new friends at her new school.

records.title: Furachi na Otoko-tachi
records.description:
Collection of one shots:

1. Furachi na Otokotachi
2. Love Communication
3. Marriage Pink
4. Can't Throw Away My Treasures
5. Calling for Love

records.title: Kiss Me Baby
records.description:
A girl gets impatient when she and her boyfriend haven't kissed yet, even though they've been dating for awhile, so she tries to take matters into her own hands.

Also, there's a oneshot after this about a girl with a similar problem as in the first story with her dating the most popular guy at school who hasn't made any moves on her.

records.title: Devil Kings
records.description:
It is a time of civil war, and the young warlords running Japan are... hopelessly stupid. This manga takes place in the Sengoku (Warring States) Period in Japan, and is based off the game Sengoku Basara, otherwise known as Devil Kings in the US. Sanada Yukimura, who serves under his master Takeda Shingen, hopes to accomplish his master's dreams of a united Japan. However, he is faced with many obstacles, forcing him to battle against many powerful warriors with the same ambitions. One of these men is Date Masamune; with his flamboyant attitude and his ideal "fun," he stirs up uncontrollable anxiety within Yukimura that draws him into the heat of battle...

Based on the video game.

records.title: Kacchu no Senshi Gamu!
records.description:
It is the Sengoku period. There was a ninja group called the Kagerou Clan, feared for their ruthless bravery against invaders. The Fang Ninja they control are armored dogs that can understand human language and use telekinesis! However, the Fang Demon Clan, also using Fang Ninja, is closing in from the shadows...!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Aishi no Dino"

records.title: Holy Talker
records.description:
With the student council executive committee of a certain school
participates secretly as the exorcist who seals the demon which today
starts overflowing. The boy priest of the puzzle which is transferred
there. You enclosed to the body of the self in him, "demon" you will
question and probably will bear one face which!

records.title: Tales of Symphonia: EXTRA LOAD
records.original_title: テイルズ オブ シンフォニア EXTRA LOAD
records.description: Short stories about the past of the Tales of Symphonia main characters.

records.title: DAN DOH!!
records.description: Dan Doh!! focuses on a fifth grader named Tadamichi Aoba also nicknamed Dandoh. Dandoh and his two friends are their baseball team's best players, but after an incident with their school principal, they are introduced the world of golf. Dandoh and his friends are taught by a former pro golfer named Shinjō Mikiyasu who believes that they can surpass even him. As Dandoh begins to play in tournaments, his friendly spirit, determination, and hard working and competitive attitude brings the best in the players around him and earns him many friends.

records.title: Koi
records.description: Mouri has been dragged into a gokon by her best friend but Mouri neither wants a boyfriend nor is afraid of showing her true self, as crude as her personality may be. But when she catches the eye of a guy just as relentless, and creepy, as her, how will she react?

records.title: Mikakunin Shounen Gedou
records.description:
Sarara’s normal life changes one day after she meets Gedou, a mysterious boy who claims himself a doctor of unidentified creatures. Sarara’s suspicion towards the young doctor results in Gedou revealing his true self to Sarara. Despite being shocked to see Gedou’s true self, Sarara decides to know more about Gedou and unidentified mysterious creatures.

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 3: Mikakunin Shounen Gedou (Pilot)

records.title: Ichigo no xxx
records.description:
A collection of four short romantic stories.


Taken from Manga Fox

records.title: Seibutsu Suisei WoO
records.description: Ai Kumashimo (14) is an energetic and friendly middle schooler. Her childhood friend, Kotarou(15), is a goofy guy who dreams of being a movie director. One day, on her way home from school, she finds an interesting looking "toy" and decides to take it home. The next morning, she finds an "alien" right next to her!! All the "alien" can say is "Woo, Woo." What's Ai going to do with it!?

records.title: DAN DOH!! Xi
records.description:
Dando Aoba, who is thirteen and called Dan Doh, following his coach Shinjo and Akano whom he respects, leaves for England to take part in All UK Open Golf Tournament. On his way, he encounters an event in Thailand.

(Source: Shogakukan)

records.title: Ashen Victor
records.description: Meet Snev, a hapless motorballer nicknamed the "Crash King."  Ever since a traumatic accident on the racetrack, Snev has been running on the edge of sanity.  Only his best friend, a beautiful prostitute, still believes in him. Then, when Snev discovers his employers' ulterior motives for keeping him on the motorball circuit, he must muster the courage to confront both them and his inner demons!

records.title: Tactics Ogre
records.description: Based on the video game.

records.title: Strange Orange
records.description:
From Osuwari Team:
“I want to get a boyfriend in high school.” Born on the same day, at the same hospital, Asuka and Tomaru were always together. Though they seem more like twins than real twins, Asuka’s desire for independence means separation… a complicated situation?!

records.title: Bokura wa Itsumo
records.description:
Nori Sakurada is riding her bike one day when she meets up with a boy she used to know when she was little. He has grown, but doesn't look very happy...

Note: The chapter count includes the one-shot "Himitsu no H-kun" from volume 1

records.title: Shout!
records.description: Beginning of college; checking out the school clubs... Nagi likes the drama club because it has a cool-looking guy whom Nagi thinks is kind. But once she joins the club he makes the club members do embarrassing things in public--and makes Nagi cry. His name is Rin, known as "Sad Yama." He won't let Nagi quit the club--and he won't let go of her either!

records.title: Kumo no Graduale
records.description: In a world similar to our early 20th century, airships are the major mean of transportation. A group of aerial bandits, know as "Zarathustra," raids airships with fascinating skills and has angered and been feared by government forces. Yet, their target is not money or treasure: in the name of peace, they locate and destroy arms sales shipped by airships.

records.title: Bus Gamer
records.original_title: Bus Gamer ビズ ゲーマー
records.description:
Toki Mishiba, Nobuto Nakajyo, and Kazuo Saitoh are hired to play the Biz Game, a game much like capture the flag, only with company secrets and insane amounts of money involved. At first they think it's a crazy but fun way to get some money, but as the game goes on, they hear stories about mysterious deaths on the news, and recognize the victims as members of the teams they've beaten in the game. When one of the losers of a game dies right in front of them, they realize what is really at stake - their very lives!

This is a re-write of the original Bus Gamer manga

records.title: Taiyou Made 3m
records.description: Taiyou, a young student, has just lost her brother who was a gifted basketball player. To honor his memory, she decides to become manager of the school's basketball club. There she meets the mysterious Mizuto Shibamura, and the ardent Hinoki Kojuurou. Both boys want to motivate and support Taiyou in the task. Which one will win her heart?

records.title: Stardust Paradise
records.description: After his mother passes away, high school student Hiroshi Houshou's long lost father suddenly reappears, with two new family members: a new mother who is also a famous actress, and her daughter, the popular and beautiful idol singer Rina Yuuki.

records.title: Suki Nante Ienai
records.description:
She was in the 3rd grade of middle school, he was in the 1st grade of high school.

She met him at the basketball match for the first time. He was so amazing, she fell in love at first sight and decided to enter the same high school he's going to.

After she managed to get into Shuuei Institute, she expects her happy love life to begin but... what if the guy she liked was held back a year?! And what if he told her to "never come near him again"?! No worries, Tachibana Riri will not give up!

records.title: Onsen de Aimashou
records.description: Although the family vacation was cancelled, our heroine decides to go forward alone. However the onsen inn turns out to be an extremely weird place! Not only is the staff all male and the gorgeous managers (a pair of brothers) are constantly fighting over the right to inherit the inn, even monkeys visit the springs as though they own it! How will our heroine ever get out of this mess?

records.title: Macross Frontier
records.original_title: マクロスフロンティア
records.description:
Macross Frontier follows the lives of Alto Saotome, Ranka Lee and a pop idol named Sheryl Nome on board the Macross Frontier colonization fleet. After the war against the Zentradi aliens, Humankind has spread across the universe in order to ensure its survival. The Macross Frontier fleet is part of a effort to spread and maintain the culture of humanity.

(Source: Anime News Network)

records.title: Kiss Blue
records.description:
When Tomosaka realized he was in love with his best friend Noda, it seemed the most natural thing in the world. He couldn't even remember when he'd first started falling in love. He had his feelings, but he couldn't express them... because Noda was his best friend. A story about the delicate thread that separates friendship and love.

(Source: Juné)

Included one-shot: He Is Waiting For Him at The Cafe

records.title: Kiseki no Koibito
records.description:
A volume of sweet, beautifully drawn oneshots from one of our favorite mangaka.

1. Imaginary Lovers
A man reunites with his college love after three years only to find out that his thoroughly male love interest has apparently conceived, given birth to and raised a son in the three years since they parted. That this is anatomically possible doesn't even occur to our slightly dopey seme, who's just overjoyed at the prospect of getting back "the one that got away" plus a rather adorable half-sized extra.

2. Brothers
Two very different boys learn to co-exist when they suddenly find themselves living together and expected to act like brothers.

3. Supreme Logic Study
Two college students bask in domestic bliss after ten years of friendship, totally unaware of their true feelings for each other.

4. Twin
When Wataru dies in a traffic accident, he thinks he has no lingering attachments to the living world... if that's so, then why can't he pass on to his next incarnation? And what's keeping the sad-eyed boy who shares his lonely rooftop?

5. Bet
A bet turns into something much more infuriating...

6. D.H.
A boy is enlisted to write love letters for his less-than-literate best friend... unfortunately, the object of his friend's affection is his own secret crush.

(Source: Doki-Doki)

records.title: The Place Promised in Our Early Days
records.original_title: 雲のむこう、約束の場所
records.description: In an alternate history of the aftermath of World War II, Japan has been cleaved in half, with the south—Honshu and the other islands—allied with the United States and the northern island Hokkaido annexed by the enigmatic Union. It was on Hokkaido that a mysterious tower had been built, a strand of metal reaching up out of the atmosphere, visible from the northern tip of Honshu. In 1996, three teenagers, Hiroki, Takuya and Sayuri, make a pact—they will build an experimental aircraft, almost invisible to surveillance, cross over to Hokkaido and unlock the secrets of the tower. Their dream was never realized, because Sayuri was sent to Tokyo for treatment after she fell into a coma. It is now three years later. The rosy illusions of youth have fallen away, but not the unbreakable strength of the trio’s promise. The truth of the tower will be uncovered, and with it, the link between it and Sayuri’s mysterious, carefully tended condition.

records.title: Innai Kansen
records.description:
1-3) Innai Kansen(Nosocomial Infection / 院内感染) & Informed Consent (Kokuchi / 告知)
A brilliant surgeon originally from a university hospital, Sawamura Iori, and a married physician, Yagi Tomoya are having an infamous affair!! They conduct their taboo affair in a hospital room where a comatose boy has been lying for the past 5 years.
One night, Tomoya was rushed to the ER due to a car accident... Is it really an accident or a suicide attempt…? Can Iori save his lover…? Suddenly the comatose boy miraculously awakens… This story intertwines all three men and their struggles for a new beginning…

4-6) Kimi no Shiawase wo Inorenai (I Can't Pray for Your Happiness / 君の幸せを祈れない) & I HAVE
A wannabe pilot meets a beautiful young man who has lingering feelings for his ex-boyfriend.

7) Residence (レジデンス)
Sou, the coma patient from the main story, finds a new start at love.

records.title: Love Songs
records.description:
A collection of one shots:

1) Love Songs
2) Zipper
3) Kakurenbou (Hide-and-Seek / かくれんぼう)
4) Koyaanisqatsi (コヤニスカッティ)

5) Migi yori no Otoko (From the Right / 右よりの男)
Keigo and Keisuke are brothers and are both in love with Takafumi. Keigo is blind in his right eye and Takafumi and Keisuke take advantage of it by doing things like mutual masturbation in the movie theatre to Keigo's right side. When Keisuke has an accident, Keigo goes to see Takafumi in New York where he's working to tell him Keisuke is dead and lives on in Keigo's new right cornea. When Takafumi reacts to the knowledge, Keigo takes advantage, but will Keigo be ever be able to be with Takafumi, or will he always be Keisuke?

6) SACRIFICE

records.title: Onnanoko wa Yoyuu!
records.description:
Tomomi is secretly in love with her classmate Sawada. But her love couldn't be fulfilled as Sawada is in love with another girl. Meanwhile, Ojika, the head of the broadcast club, is trying to win Tomomi's heart with his handsome voice. Finally Tomomi's gloom is driven away. She starts to see the hidden beauty of the things around her which she has never noticed before.

Note: Includes the one shot Hitsuji-tachi no March (羊たちのマーチ)

records.title: Onee-chan no Kuchibiru
records.original_title: お姉ちゃんのくちびる
records.description: Two sisters love each other but can't admit it yet.

records.title: Desert Guardian
records.description: Early Hirano Kohta one-shot hentai manga about a Nazi soldier in the Middle East.

records.title: Itazura: Ijiwaru Tenshi
records.original_title: 悪戯　イジワル天使
records.description: Ijiwaru Tenshi Ayumi is a high school student. Her friend's brother, Shouma, is younger than her, but he looks handsome and older! Shouma asks Ayumi for her digits right off the bat, and he's smooth like a player--not really Ayumi's type. The more time she spends with him, though, the more she likes him. But is Shouma really sent from heaven... or is he just a tease?

records.title: Kaizoku Game
records.description: A spin-off oneshot of Ousama Game, involving, yet another Prince (5th) ... and, of course, a Pirate...

records.title: Innocent World
records.original_title: イノセント・ワールド
records.description: "In our class room, everyone has worries behind their smiles. Parents divorcing, complexes, kissing… The main characters in these stories are living with pain or anxiety, but they are still shining brilliantly. (Source: Osuwari Team)

records.title: MIXiM★11
records.original_title: ミクシム・イレブン MIXiM★11
records.description: Matsui Ichimatsu, Haruno Koume, and Sanguubashi Takezou are old friends with one thing in common: despite their good looks, they're incredibly unpopular with the ladies. But what does Polaris have to do with their fate? Who's that strange girl? And what does Nobuyuki Anzai (author of Flame of Recca and MAR) have in store for us this time?

records.title: CLAMP School Paranormal Investigators
records.original_title: CLAMP学園怪奇現象研究会事件ファイル
records.description: Join the five students that make up the "CLAMP School Paranormal Investigators" on their misadventures as they undercover the supernatural truth behind paranormal events on CLAMP Campus.

records.title: Red Riding Hood Chacha
records.description: Chacha, a young magical girl who's spells never seem to come out quite right, along with her friends Riiya (a warewolf) and Shiine (a young wizard), have various misadventures.

records.title: Kamisama Onegai!
records.description:
Life was a mundane chore for student council member Hasumi Ryou, until he picked up a charm on the floor. Suddenly a junior high-school student with bad grades appears in his room calling him Kami-sama and asks for help to pass her high school entrance exam. Not to mention that it doesn't make sense that his room changes into hers everyday after school, Ryou abandons all logic and decides to go with the flow, his heart touched by the earnest desire of the girl who wants to graduate to high school.

(Source: Shoujo Crusade)

records.title: Giri Koi
records.description: Mao has just graduated middle school, and due to where she lives, she has to go to a different school from all her friends. While trying to find her new classroom, Mao stumbles upon a boy being bullied. She gets the bullies to go away, only to find that the boy, Riku, wasn't being bullied at all. Nonetheless, Riku respects her now, and refers to her as "Prince", for saving him. How will their relationship continue...?

records.title: Kinou Ie Nakatta Koto
records.original_title: 昨日、いえなかったこと
records.description:
Misaki's dream of becoming a nursery school teacher is not something she can tell her parents about, and she just goes about her daily life. But on the rooftop of her school, she meets her classmate, Takashima, who is a yankee and wears gold pants...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

records.title: Candy Flower
records.original_title: キャンディ・フラワー
records.description:
1. Candy Flower (キャンディ・フラワー)
Kobayakawa loves to tend the Garden Club plot behind the school and dream about handsome Yagi. Mizuki Aihara loves to sleep away the day on the garden bench and mooch her candies. But Aihara proves to be a good source of advice on how to catch Yagi's interest. Soon Kobayakawa basks in the glow of Yagi and friends attention. But she's pressured to leave her beloved garden...
2. Koi ga, Hajimaru (恋が，はじまる。, Love Begins.)
3. Tomato to 14-sai (トマトと14歳)
4. Yuki no Hana (ゆきのはな, Snow Flower)
5. Mashiro (まっしろ)
6. Puchi-tomato to 15-sai (プチトマトと15歳)

records.title: Houkago Host Club
records.description:
Compilation of short stories:

1. Koisuru Himitsu (Loving Secret)
A woman who was going to graduate to become a teacher and for her last day of freedom she went to a host club, she fell in love with the most popular host of the club and spent the night with him. The next day...

2. Houkago Host Club (After School Host Club)
Ever since kindergarten, Sumiko grew up never knowing love. At her school, they enforced strict discipline. Yet, tonight is the last "Free Night." Will Sumiko be taught "first love" by heading for that place?

3. Snow Black Christmas
It’s Christmas Eve and Fuuka is preparing to meet with her boyfriend. They’ve been dating for 3 months and she’s still not sure she’s suppose to spend the night with him, but in the end she gave in to his pressure. Her date goes all wrong when she is seduced by a beautiful dancer called Take. Who is Fukka going to choose?
(Source: Evil Flowers)

4. Sadistic Darling

records.title: Akuma de Koibito.
records.description:
Ever since she was young, Rinko has always been labelled as a 'Ohito yoshi baka' by everyone except for a young boy, Itsuki. Since then, Rinko has always had strong feelings for Itsuki but will he ever be like that angel-like person she meet as a child or stay as the Akuma she has now gotten used to?

Included one shots:
That's the Rabbit's Forest
Because, It's Love

records.title: Anata e no Crescendo
records.original_title: あなたへのクレッシェンド
records.description: "When you can play this tune, play it for me..." Suzuno has always been searching for the boy who told her that, whom she met at a piano recital when she was small. After entering high school, she was chosen to play the piano to accompany a chorus competition. Suzuno started practicing with Aiba-kun and Fujisawa-kun from her class, but Fujisawa-kun told her that they used to meet when they were small...!?

records.title: Annyui na Kanojo
records.description: At the age of 17, Kozue thinks that she is no longer interested in men. Nevertheless, before she knows, she finds herself attracted to Asano, her kind, experienced teacher. Now she is passionately in love with him, and she tries to give him up many times, but...!?

records.title: Ashita no Nadja
records.description: Ashita no Nadja is the story of a young girl who grew up in an orphanage in England. One day she learns she may not be an orphan after all, and suddenly finds herself chased by some strange men. She ends up fleeing the orphanage and joins a travelling troupe of entertainers. The show follows her travels across Europe as she tries to find her mother and figure out who she really is. She meets many new people, makes lots of friends, and finds herself falling for two boys- Francis, the son of a wealthy family, and the Black Rose, a mysterious masked thief.

records.title: Watashi no Oujisama
records.description:
1 Volume, 5 short stories.

1) My Prince (Watashi no Oujisama) : A rich man and a poor man appear before Hanako, an office lady who used to be rich. She wavers over which man to choose. Her feelings are comically described.

records.title: Boku no Platinum Lady
records.original_title: ボクのプラチナレディー
records.description:
The super-expensive Joka Gakuen has a policy where the valedictorian, platinum student (PS), is exempt from school fees. Ai supports her large family in place of her parents, so she has little money. She takes Joka Gakuen's entrance exam because she wants to become the PS. Her dream comes true as she gets the top mark, but...!?

(Source: Shogakukan)

records.title: Chiki Chiki Banana
records.description: Two bold and daring high school girls, Naomi and Jennifer have no enemies! They must certainly have many perverted stories to tell...or so you'd think. But they are actually pure virgins! The two finally get boyfriends, and their hearts beat fast as they look forward to their first sexual experiences, but!?

records.title: Chuugakusei Subetega. Hajimete Datta
records.original_title: 中学生　すべてが。初めてだった
records.description: Rika likes teacher Aisaka very much. When she is alone with him, she declares her love to him. But he gave her the cold-shoulder. Deeply disappointed, Rika accidentally tips over bottles of chemicals in the science room, and is injured on the back. Aisaka feels that he is responsible, and announces his engagement to her. Rika feels sad about his tenderness, because she thinks that it is only the because of her injury.

records.title: Dame Dame Darling
records.description: Fuka is crazy about Haruka, her senior whom she loved at first sight. It is said, however, that Haruka is cursed by Fate, and if he had sex, he could break the spell. Is it true, Haruka!?

records.title: Debut Kara Hajimatta
records.original_title: デビューからはじまった
records.description: This is a story about two girls (Yuka & Maho) who dream of becoming famous mangaka. Each chapter tells a phase in their career, starting from their first audition in a manga writing competition, until they become professional mangaka.

records.title: Un Carnet de Bal
records.description: Masahiro, who is a duke, has been studying abroad since he was young to learn about Western culture. Now he is teaching ballroom dancing/ettiquette and keeps getting strange looks from one of his students, Fukaya. He notices his interest even more when he's looking at Masahiro's portrait on a dance card/booklet and decides to seduce him. And the drama, intrigue, and treachery ensues.

records.title: Fredward-shi no Ahiru
records.original_title: フレッドウォード氏のアヒル
records.description:
Following the scandal involving his latest work, famous suspense novelist Kevin Fredward retires to the countryside to escape the media and the demands of city life. He posts a want ad for a new housekeeper, but who should come knocking at his door, but Rosemary — a talking duck!! As wise as she is competent, Rosemary soon becomes a permanent part of Kevin's life. Under Rosemary's guidance, Kevin takes the steps to stop running from his past in order to change himself and his future.
Written in the style of a neo-romantic fairy tale, this is a dramatic series about a young man's attempt to find hope and moral redemption.

Notes:
- Includes 4 extra chapters

records.title: Super Love Potion
records.original_title: Super Love Potion-スーパーラブポーション
records.description: Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

records.title: Gentlemen's Agreement Between a Rabbit and a Wolf
records.original_title: ウサギと狼の紳士協定
records.description:
Co-workers Kai and Toga have an ongoing feud that makes them look like sworn enemies! But their snarling sarcasm barely conceals the fact that they’re wild for one another. Can a lonely, lovelorn rabbit and a ravenous wolf learn to play nice…or will they devour one another in a flurry of fur?

(Source: Juné)

records.title: Drown in Maniac!
records.original_title: Maniac ni Oborero! Erotic ni Oborero! Bangaihen
records.description: Tougo drops by with a present for his lover, which is probably more for himself than for Tomoharu to enjoy.

records.title: Cheerful Eros Project
records.description:
Collection of 10 short stories including:

• HSS: His sister is envy of his girlfriend. Suddenly, his girlfriend saw them in an inexcusable position. Then she asks to join the fun!!

• Oniichan wa Shinpaishou (Onii-chan's a Worry Wart): He follows his sister to protect her. After get rid of a rapist who covers her eyes, he pretends to be one to try to teach his sister a lesson.

• 147 Centimeters: "Even if I'm tiny, I'm still your Onee-san"

Youhei Saito's big sister Mayu isn't very big at all, at 147 Centimeters tall.

Mayu needs something on top of the highest shelf, and while getting a "boost" from Youhei, things lead to a compromising situation...

records.title: Foxy Lady
records.original_title: しっぷうかれんじんらいこむすめ!
records.description: Jin Mikasa, the heir to a 300-year-old shrine, encounters a girl from his past, who also happens to be a half-demon fox, Kogane. Her wish is to become human, but to do so, she must mate with the heir to a shrine.

records.title: Pops.
records.description: In Pops, a girl exploits her broken leg to get some extra care from her friend.

records.title: Sono Kuchibiru ni Yoru no Tsuyu
records.description: Wada Tatsuki seems to be an ordinary bus driver, living a simple and peaceful life. However there is a heavy burden he holds in his heart, a terrible thing that he has done in the past. What if one day the man he hurt appears and wants to take revenge? (Source: Wasurenagusa)

records.title: Let's Akuma Tech Kyoushitsu
records.description: After getting rejected by her crush for the tenth time, Minami mopes in the library. Smart and handsome school idol Kouki notices her there and offers to teach her "love tech" to help her catch her crush's eye.

records.title: Shin Angyo Onshi Gaiden
records.description: A series of short stories portraying the past of some characters from Shin Angyo Onshi...

records.title: Koeru
records.description: A man’s nightmares turn out to be anything but... His wife has disappeared, his Grandma is too weak to care for herself, and theres a strange growth appearing nearby in the woods....

records.title: Blue Sky
records.original_title: 青い空があればそれでいい
records.description:
Kihara longs for some stimulation in his life at the boarding school. As the dorm leader, he decides to use his authority and tamper with the new student housing lottery. He ends up living in the same room with Yoshimi, who's known as "the beautiful ice king, and Kihara’s life is anything but dull!
from juné

records.title: Ugly Duckling's Love Revolution
records.original_title: 乙女的恋革命★ラブレボ!!
records.description:
Welcome to the prestigious Saint Leaf School, where, among other things, the boys are so pretty they give the girls a run for their money! Amidst this bed of flowers exists one Hitomi Sakuragawa, a sweet girl with a not-so-little weight problem, who lives in a nearby apartment owned by her doting older brother. Hitomi also happens to have pretty much the best luck on the planet: Her neighbors are some of the hottest guys in school! But will she need to steel her willpower, cut out the cookies, and slim down before they'll even give her the time of day? Or will they be charmed by her kindhearted, genuine personality? It won't be long before Hitomi discovers that the road to a healthy lifestyle is paved with hilarity!

(Source: Yen Press)

records.title: Strawberry Holiday
records.original_title: ストロベリィ▽ホリデー
records.description: Nana Asou is 14. Her dream is to have the life of a normal girl!? Constantly super busy as an idol superstar, one day she makes her escape!! Throwing everything away, she somehow winds up with…a cake baker!?

records.title: Kiichi and the Magic Books
records.description:
With his horned head and pointed ears, young Kiichi resembles a demon. When his mother dies, he is ostracized from his village. Alone and with no clue to his true origin, he meets Mototaro, a traveling "Library Man" who goes from town to town, lending out books. When Kiichi spies some magical creatures literally jumping out of the pages of one of these books, he thinks he may be on the way to finding out where he came from. Mototaro and Hana – his young assistant – agree to let Kiichi accompany them. Together, they will encounter strange creatures and adventures while Kiichi tries to find his place in the world.

(Source: CMX)

records.title: Zombie Fairy
records.description:
A boy named Aoto brings a family heirloom — a coffin — to a Japanese TV show to determine its worth. Suddenly, a 400-year-old Chinese girl named Chun-Ai pops out of the coffin. In a trance-like state, she becomes violent and super-strong and trashes the studio. After she emerges from her trance and calms down, Aoto decides he has no choice but to bring her home, where his quirky family agrees to take her in. But they soon find themselves in over their heads — Chun-ai is quickly joined by a friend from the past, and then they find themselves in the middle of a deadly battle with a giant, raging tiger spirit.

(Source: CMX)

records.title: New Beginnings
records.description:
Time and distance is what Keigo has to conquer, when – at a very young age – he gets separated from best bud Chihiro, due to his family’s moving overseas. As the years go by, his separation from his friend becomes so unbearable that it forces Keigo to become a withdrawn shut-in. Chihiro’s mother, after hearing the news, takes pity on the boy and offers to watch over him if he wishes to come home.

Reunited with Chihiro, Keigo unceremoniously blurts out, “I love you, Chihiro. I totally love you! Ever since the past! I’m in love with you!” With the truth out in the open, everything should all be well and good, except for two things: 1) Chihiro is creeped out because they’re both guys, and 2) he’s already in love with one of the girls at school.

(Source: Juné)

records.title: Kizoku no Aoi Seppun
records.description: Kikuchi Yo, a travel agency owner dreams of turning the "Blue Rose", a British noble mansion into a hotel. He enthusiastically approaches Baron Gilfred, owner of the mansion, with his plans. Unbeknownst to him, he's walking into the Baron's trap…! A gorgeous love story between a nobleman and a business owner.

records.title: Parabellum
records.description: On the very first day that Kuze Aoi transferred to Hinomiya Academy, he finds himself facing down the barrel of a gun. He is introduced to the campus and the student body by his childhood friend Miyabi and learns about the prince and princess among students, Shitara Sagiri and Hinomiya Kuon. Sagiri is a cool and beautiful while Kuon is elegant and magnificent. After school, Aoi gets lost on campus and Kuon begins shooting at him and he's barely saved by a random girl named Atarashi Sonoko. It seems that Aoi holds a secret that is critical in a feud between two old, powerful families.

records.title: Sengoku Strays
records.description: Kasane is your average kendo-obsessed girl, when a brush with a mysterious sword sends her back in time to the Sengoku Era. Stuck in an unfamiliar time and place, Kasane also has the poor luck of winding up right in the middle of the turmoil that surrounded Oda Nobunaga's rise to power!

records.title: Ai wa Kagerou
records.description: My shadow is a cute, chubby girl! We're inseparable, even in the bath and toilet!? Ai, a beautiful girl shadow who is the opposite gender to Kagerou, appears to take his place! But in the middle of their pleasurable body-swapping ritual, they are interrupted by Ton-chan, who claims to be his girlfriend, and only their lower bodies (or rather, their crotches) are swapped!? What will become of Kagerou, who has become a shadow, and Ai, the beautiful girl whose crotch remains male...?

records.title: Amigo x Amiga
records.description: Riruka Imumaru is absolutely obsessed with soccer—a true fanatic. Her passion and skill will undoubtedly remind many of Tsubasa from Captain Tsubasa. Determined to follow in the footsteps of the legendary Joichiro Konno, she enrolls at Hakata no Mori High School, eager to join its soccer club. Everything seems straightforward—except for two significant challenges: Riruka is deaf, and the soccer club is more of a chaotic mess than an actual team.

records.title: Oyama! Kikunosuke
records.description:
The main character, Kikunosuke Fujii, arrives at the prestigious girls' high school "Kurogami Gakuen" under the guise of studying the female form, and gets into trouble one after another in this school comedy.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

records.title: Arashi no Yoru ni
records.original_title: 漫画版　あらしのよるに
records.description: A story about a goat and a wolf who become friends in a stormy night, and how they overcome differences and hardships.

records.title: Atomic Nekokabutsu
records.description: Heidi, Grandpa, and Peter are all in tears! Switzerland is gone!?! The most terrifyingly cute and action-packed climax!!!! After an unimaginable journey through a deadly labyrinth, Anne and her family finally arrive at their fateful land, Switzerland. There, they inevitably encounter their pursuer, Schindler, a hellish gourmand. Can they turn the tables and rescue Lena, who has been swallowed whole by his powerful mouth that devours everything without discrimination? The high-energy, suspenseful game concludes in a spectacular fashion!!!!

records.title: Ayakashi
records.description:
Ayakashi is a parasite life force that gives superpowers to its host, taking in return the host's entire life force. Yu Kusaka is a student that lost his will to live after the death of a dear childhood friend, until the day a mysterious girl, named Eim Yoake, appears. From that moment on, his life would never be the same again. Hunted by Ayakashi and their hosts, the power within Yu awakens and a never ending battle begins.

(Source: Wikipedia)

records.title: Dreams
records.description: Takeshi Kuri, a juvenile delinquent, has a talent for baseball, but smokes cigarettes, has brown hair, and hits people when he gets mad. By the time he was in junior high school, he had played on six different teams, four of which were suspended and two of which were disbanded. He was often ejected from games early on, or had to forfeit games, and was regarded as a useless pitcher by those involved. After being rejected by a number of prestigious schools, he was given one last chance at Yumenoshima High School. During the interview, he hit the manager, Kudo, but somehow managed to pass on one condition. The condition was that he would live with the coach at his house. Kudo is a man who once worked as a coach at the prestigious Toyo. On the first day of school, Kuri took the field in a red and white match. However, he is harassed by the head of the department, who values discipline and common sense. Hisato overcame many hardships and went on a rampage at the South Tokyo Tournament and Koshien. The insane baseball team creates a whirlwind nationwide.

records.title: Lollipo Unlimited
records.description:
In a not-so-distant future Japan, the popularity of maid cafés have skyrocketed, and maids are revered as national idols. Battles are fought between the maid cafés to determine which one is the best at serving their masters, and they are all aspiring to be like the supreme maid and waitress (which is an anime character), Minori-chan! Kamagaya Misaki is close to achieving that goal - all she needs is Minori-chan's original maid uniform, which is rumored to exist in real life! However, it seems that the secret behind Minori-chan and her uniform is...?

(Source: Mangafox)

records.title: Shuu 7
records.description:
Collection of one-shots:

1. Shuu 7 (7 Days of Week)
2. LoveChuu (In Love)
3. Koi no Kajitsu (Fruit of Love)
4. Sweet Little Winter

records.title: Maid wo Nerae!: Nakabayashi Kouchou no Yabou
records.original_title: メイドをねらえ! ~中林校長の野望~
records.description:
This one is a spinoff from Kore ga Watashi no Goshujin sama. The story is about a school, Shiritsu Yurihime Gakuen, an all girl school specialized in preparing maid for the otaku moe industry. Of course, the leader is no less, a Nakabayashi, a heavy-class otaku with unlimited asset to burn for while seven generations.

Our main heroine this time is Mochida Natsumi, a girl with hentai mind as worse as Yoshitaka and luck as bad as Izumi. She came with the ambition of building harem of imouto. But life is not as beautiful as in those harem love comedy genre anime/manga, because in this school, all the girls are well educated in otaku business.

Her couple is Kitamura Kiriko, a.k.a Mitsuki 2. Cute, innocent (looks) and demonic personality to the bone and teeth. She's also Natsumi's roommate, imouto, as well as goshujin sama.

(Source: Suiheisen)

records.title: Himena Kamena
records.description: A busty girl and a mysterious schoolbag-shaped turtle suddenly appear in Iwakikaki Town. Meanwhile, the Iwakikaki Town Vigilante Group, which deals with all sorts of things that threaten the peace of the town, is hit by a mysterious incident... but... A highly anticipated new work from Yuki Shinichi!

records.title: Mato-chan
records.description:
Mato-chan is a 3rd grade elementary school girl that likes bugs sooo much. Take a look at Mato-chan and friends' daily life!

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

records.title: Chiro-chan
records.description: A young girl transfers to a new school. Greeted by a tall bug-loving-classmate, her biggest fears are now at risk of becoming known; bugs and people looking down on her.

records.title: Maria Holic
records.description:
Kanako is excited to be transferring into a new all-girl mission school. She’s looking for her ideal yuri partner. When she meets Mariya Shidou she thinks she’s found the one. But wait! Mariya is a cross-dressing sadistic boy and now Kanako is forced to keep his secret! But that’s not all. To complicate things she’s drawing the attention of the most popular girl in school and, at the same time, catching the wrath of all the other girls. Will Kanako ever find the cute girl of her dreams? Or will she die of sexual-frustration nosebleeds? Love is a complicated affair for Kanako and the girls of Maria Holic.

(Source: One Peace Books)

records.title: Clear Qualia
records.description: In a distant Island, people suffer from a strange disease called "Pinocchio". This disease causes patient's limbs to rot, and before long, leads to death. But disease can be cured by using artificial limbs or "exchanging" limbs of people with special antibodies. These people with the antibodies, who only exist one in ten-thousand, are called "Doner", and their bodies considered national treasures. One day, Dorothy, a Doner, exchanges her precious right eye for a male Plastica(robot servents) who was about to get thrown away. Their meeting sparks the beginning of a story of a strange master and her strange Plastica.

records.title: Sora ni Taiyou ga Aru Kagiri
records.original_title: 空に太陽がある限りっ。
records.description: Rieko Edogawa is a second year student at East Edogawa Academy - a private school. She is full of energy and courage, and she is so popular that there is not a soul in her town or school that doesn't know her. But Rieko's one weakness is Teppei Sakamiya, her childhood friend. She has liked him for a long time, but Teppei can only see her as a good friend. Meanwhile... Naoto Akutsu, a transfer student, appears... (Source: ShoujoMagic)

records.title: Oya ni wa Naisho
records.description: Her elder sister Tsukiko goes to Tokyo University, and younger brother Aoi is a third-year student of a prestigious junior high school. Machiko, who was brought up between those smart sister and brother, has an inferiority complex about her ability.

records.title: Atashi ni Tsuiterasshai
records.original_title: あたしについてらっしゃい
records.description: Megumi's home is a real estate agency. One day, one of her clients goes missing in Hawaii. She suspects a big realty company named Hibino!? (Source: Sugar-Oasis)

records.title: Usotsuki na Season
records.description:
Usotsuki na Season is four chapters long. In it we meet young female student Miyabi, who just entered a new school. But Miyabi has a secret, she can see dead people and other paranormal things. To solve this, she wears a special pendant that supresses her powers. However, in her new school, there will be some problems that will make her have to use her special gift!

Note: Includes the short story Manatsu no Door (真夏のドア).

records.title: Yasashii Keredo Ijiwaru de
records.original_title: 優しいけれど意地悪で
records.description:
A collection of one-shots:

- Yasashii Keredo Ijiwaru de
- Yasashii Keredo Ijiwaru de
- Bouquet for You
- Unexpected Disaster

records.title: Unplugged Boy
records.description: Not only does Jee Yool have high school to worry about, she has her love life to worry about, too! The guy she likes, Hyun Kyum, doesn't see her (or any other women) as more than a friend and some guy she's not interested in is obsessed with her! Her life gets more complicated, and those complications don't even include trouble from the class delinquent...

records.title: 17-sai no Natsu Koi ni Shinu
records.description:
I am going to kill myself before I turn 18. Toru Natsu is filled with despair about love, life, and herself. Her parents only care about themselves, she is being forced into an arranged marriage with someone she doesn't love, and she is unable to escape from any of it. Then, in the summer of her 17th year, she meets Kairiku…?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Included Stories:
1. 17-sai no Natsu Koi ni Shinu (17歳の夏恋に死ぬ)
2. Koi no Yukue wa, Wakaranai (恋の行方は、わからない)
3. Torokeru Yubisaki (とろけるゆびさき)

records.title: Aishite Aisare Nakucchane!
records.original_title: 愛して愛されなくっちゃね!
records.description:
Love is life! Mako is a super energetic high school girl for whom love is everything. One day, she falls in love at first sight with Shinya, the most tough guy in school. She confesses her feelings immediately, but is rejected on the spot. But, this burning feeling won't disappear! She will keep on attacking and attacking and attacking until she can make this love come true.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

records.title: Daite...
records.description:
1. *Daite...*

2. *Mashiro no Kanata*

records.title: Dynamite Ai × Otoko
records.description: Note: Inclues one extra chapter.

records.title: Gyutto Shite D
records.description: Aiko has always maintained her ideas of what her first love should be like. At the secret coffee shop "BOYS cafe", she met D, a guy who makes her excited. And D meaning "Danger"! How dangerous could D be? What kind of exciting love relationship will happen between him and Aiko?

records.title: Tenka Muteki R
records.description: Suzume Igarashi (14) is a junior high school student and the youngest daughter of the family. Suzume has three older brothers—Ryo (19), Take (17), and Tora (16)—and this has influenced her way of being a girl. After entering high school, girls in the class began to set aside and her childhood friend, Jiro, does not want to tarnish his reputation. Everything begins to change and Suzume is beginning to feel very alone, until she learns that there are rumors that Jiro is going out with Shiratori, a girl who knows her brother Ryo.

records.title: Blue Ribon
records.description: Konatsu's dream is to become a movie director. She falls in love with a popular actor, Aoi Nonomiya, and decides to confess to him upon her friends' encouragement. But...

records.title: Good-bye
records.description:
A collection of short stories:

1. Good-bye (グッド・バイ); Ribon 2002 Spring Special Issue
2. Sakura Renren Kimi no Koto (さくら恋々きみのこと); Ribon Original 2003-08
3. Cherish! (チェリッシュ!); Ribon Original 2002-10
4. Itoshi no Carry (いとしのキャリー); Ribon Original 2002-02

records.title: As the Pool Floods with Water
records.description:
Tetsuo was the nice, quiet kid that everybody knows. Until well-meant prodding on the part of Satoshi made him chose the 'easy' way out. He purposely failed the entrance exam to a good school, and picked fights so that he wouldn't have to be around Hanada anymore.

The last thing he expected or wanted was for strong-willed Ryouji to show any interest in him. The sparks fly between the two, while Iriya's best friend Ryouta watches jealously....

records.title: G・Defend
records.description:
The year is 2022. The Diet has been hit by a series of political terrorist attacks. A new security force, the Kokkai-Keibitai (Diet Garrison), has been established. Then, the terrorist organization begins to target the instructors in charge.

Ishikawa, the eighth-generation instructor, is the only one who has managed to evade the dangers thanks to the desperate efforts of his beloved SP Iwase...

Morimoto Shu's near-future love and action!

(Source: Tosuisha, translated)

records.title: Kitty
records.description:
A collection of stories:

1. Kitty (キティ); Ribon Original 2005-02

2. Nagareboshi ni Kuchizuke (流れ星にくちづけ); Ribon 2005-02
Yawara and Chitose are childhood friends who are constantly arguing and teasing each other. Unbeknownst to Yawara, Chitose is in love with him, however, she doesn't have the guts to confess. She assures herself by thinking that they live in the same apartment complex and that they will go to the same high school, which gives her all the time she needs. However, all that changes when Yawara announces to her that he'll be going to Kura High, which is 2 hours by train, instead of the same high school as her. What if he gets a girlfriend there? What will Chitose do!?

3. Boy, Don Quixote (ボーイ、ドン・キホーテ); Ribon 2004-09
Hiro moved away 5 years ago. She and her childhood friend Ri-chan had promised to meet again and that he would fulfill his dream. And now they are going to the same school. Hiro thinks they will start up where they left off, but Ri-chan is acting very cold to her.

4. Soprano (ソプラノ); Ribon Original 2004-06
5. Kyoukasho wo Tojitara (教科書をとじたら); Ribon 2003-11

records.title: Loose Leaf
records.description: Yuki Anno just turned into a high school student. From the beginning everything seemed to go wrong. Yuki is very nervous and what's worse, she is in a different class from her best friend Jiu. Yuki feels unwanted and decides to make new friends. Upon arriving at her new class, she is frightened to see so many people and out of class, but a boy, Yuki Saeki, grabs and welcomes her, saying it is the cousin of Jiu. Saeki receives a sheet of paper and Yuki both converse wrote. Yuki goes to see him and Jiu and says that he would like to be the manager of the football team, but was not sure because there are other girls in class that she could do better.

records.title: Mayonaka ni Kiss
records.description:
Natori Nono is a very tough school-girl, she lives with her widowed mother Ayame and her younger brother Takumi in a very small apartment, where she does all the chores. Her boyfriend wants money from her, because he's really poor, too. But one day, Nono discovers that her mother remarried! She married Ichijou Hayato, the owner of the 'Ichijou Group'. Now, Nono lives there (in unaccustomed riches) with her mother, her brother, her stepfather AND her new stepbrother: Ichijou Kasuomi (his father calls him Omi-kun)!!! At first, Nono thinks Kasuomi is not nice. But what will happen next?

Notes:
- Includes one-shot "130cm kara Merry Christmas (130cmからメリークリスマス)".
- Includes the one-shot "Sayonara Marigold (さよならマリーゴールド)".

records.title: Mahou no Te ni Notte
records.description: Hachimoto Satsuki is an aspiring hairstylist who meets with legendary "Magical Hairstylist" , Hayama Ryuichi, who allows her to work for him. Fairly entertaining situations grow from this relationship as Satsuki meets others and learns more about being a hairstylist.

records.title: CALL MY NAME
records.description:
A collection of one-shots by Sakisaka Io

1. Call My Name (CALL MY NAME)
The first person that Shouko has gone out with is the first person that she has confessed to. His name is Asakawa. The only problem is, the girlfriend he treasured so much just dumped him two months ago. If he really does love Shouko, then he would call her by her name as she wants him to. So why won't he though?

2. Toumei no Yume o Miteru (透明の夢をみてる)
3. Pink ni Naritai. (ピンクになりたい。)
4. "Suki" nante Iwanai (「好き」なんて言わない)
5. Ai no Aru Fuukei (愛にある風景)

records.title: The Climber
records.description:
Transfer student Buntaro Mori starts his first day at his new school already on the administration’s radar. He’s withdrawn and sullen, and the teachers are just waiting for him to explode. When his annoying classmate Miyamoto promises to leave him alone forever if he climbs to the top of the school, Mori eagerly takes up the challenge and shocks everyone when he makes it all the way to the roof. Flushed with the victory of his first successful climb, Mori can’t resist the lure of the local peak, despite warnings from more experienced climbers about the risks of climbing alone. But Mori doesn’t care. A little danger is nothing in the face of his new obsession.

(Source: VIZ Media)

records.title: Masuraou
records.description:
In a little town near Osaka, an old tradition is being perpetuated. Every year, for hundreds of years, the men of the town defy each others in the "grand ceremony of Masuraou". Their weapons? Their courage and their fists! Their goals? Becoming the the king of the town!

It's in this atmosphere that Takeshi Yamato, a young high schooler from Tokyo, moves in. Ex-gang leader decorated with an incredible secret, he is decided to forget the past and become a socially acceptable guy... However, between his secret being found out, the fights, the girls and the messing up with his friends, he is far from becoming a model high schooler!

Note: The chapter count includes 2 extra stories.

records.title: Strobe Edge
records.description:
Ninako’s friend Daiki throws her for a loop when he expresses romantic interest in her. She cares for him, but can she return his feelings? As she tries to sort out her confusion, Ninako realizes that there are many different facets of love—strange and wonderful sides…

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

records.title: Mascara Blues
records.description:
A collection of one-shots by Sakisaka Io.

1. Mascara Blues (マスカラ ブルース)
Mugino is a normal high school girl who is extremely excited about love and is in the constant search for it. But it seems that no matter how obsessed she is with a guy, the moment the feeling is reciprocated, she falls right back out of love. Will she ever be able to break the cycle?

2. Romance no Rinkaku (ロマンスの輪郭)
When commuting to school one day, Tsuda-san tripped and spilled the entire contents of her bag on the street in front of the bus. Flustered and embarrassed, she didn't catch a glimpse of the kind person who helped her gather her things, nor did she even thank him. Feeling guilty ever since, she's tried to find him, but with no luck so far...

3. Watashi ga Watashi de Aru Tame ni: Nagai Yume (私が私であるためにー長い夢ー)
Hikaru first met Mashima-san, a hair-stylist student, when he ran into her on the street and offered to cut Hikaru's hair for free. Hikaru's friends warned that hair-stylists are notorious players, but Hikaru meets Mashima-san again anyway and feels even more attracted to him. Can Hikaru trust Mashima-san enough to tell him everything?

records.title: Kimi Bakkari no Sekai
records.description:
A collection of one-shots by Sakisaka Io.

1. Kimi bakkari no Sekai (君ばっかりの世界)
Yoshikawa Yuriko is a first year student who's in the same class as her crush, Seya Takashi. She believes that her feelings for him are not reciprocated and so therefore, remains silent about it. But her friend tells her that she too likes Seya and intends on confessing to him. How will Yuriko respond to that and who's this person that he likes?

2. Pikapika Orange (ピカピカオレンジ)
3. Onnanoko. Otokonoko. (女のコ。男のコ。)
4. Otokonoko. Onnanoko. (男のコ。女のコ。)

records.title: Gate of Planet
records.description:
A collection of one-shots by Sakisaka Io.

1. Gate of Planet (GATE OF PLANET)
Shimamine Sakura is a first year high school student who appears gaudy. Because of that, the boys misunderstand her and she isn't able to get along with the girls... and the only one to protect her is her childhood friend, Kankurou, whom she has had a crush on for 10 years. But Kankurou has found his own love...?

2. Koi Shizuku (恋雫)
3. Ashita Miru Yume (明日みる夢)
4. Next World (NEXT WORLD)

(Source: MangaUpates)

records.title: Bye-Bye, Little.
records.description:
A collection of one-shots by Sakisaka Io.

1. Bye-Bye, Little. (バイバイ、リトル。)
Ai is a first year high-school student whose father passed away when she was still in elementary school. Her immature younger brother is a pain, she has to do all the housework and it's awkward being around her own friends. But Takahashi-kun is secretly supporting her in the shadows... a story about growing up.

2. Koi to Baka to Watashi (恋と馬鹿と私, Love, Stupid, Me)
Chie wishes that her boyfriend Satoshi would show her more affection, but she knows he doesn't like the clingy type. The fact that she's hated by Satoshi's friend Sugiyama Sei doesn't help. However, it turns out that he doesn't hate her after all...

3. Watashi no Mune wa Chirichiri to (私の胸チリチリと)
Miyuki's in love with Shuntaro, but she won't confess because she's afraid of ruining their relationship. But when another girl confesses to Shuntaro, something begins to change...

4. Too Young (TOO YOUNG)
Mika's mom doesn't approve of her relationship with Yoshiyuki, her boyfriend. In fact, she doesn't approve of anything Mika does, whether it be losing piano contests or getting Bs on her tests. How far will Mika go to protect their love?

records.title: Blue
records.description: Anna entered the same high school as the person she loved. But that person is in fact her cousin, Reiji. While continuing to conceal her feelings for him, she begins to suspect that Reiji is love with Rui, her best friend. But what is Rui's real secret?...

records.title: Girlish Season
records.original_title: ガーリッシュ シーズン
records.description: Contains four short stories.

records.title: The Lapis Lazuli Crown
records.description:
Will Miel ever get motivated to use her magical powers?

In the kingdom of Savarin, it's not uncommon to have magical powers. But young Miel really isn't interested in developing her own, despite her family's history as some of the most important magicians in the realm. She's trying to live a more mundane life, much to the frustration of Sara, her olrder, over-achieving sister. Her life changes one day when she meets a young man on the street who claims to be a stranger in town. Is it only a coincidence that he looks like the reclusive young Prince Radian?

(Source: CMX)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Hinagiku Romance (ひなぎくろまんす, Daisy Romance)".

records.title: Watashi no Cinderella
records.description:
Princess Tsubaki, who loves romantic stories, is told by her father, the king, to choose a guy to date at her 16th birthday party at all costs. Troubled by this, princess Tsubaki asked a favor of Aoi, a boy who's treated like a Cinderella...!

Note: Includes the one-shot "Quartet Cards".

records.title: 3 Years
records.description: With her brother's influence, China grew up to become very boyish. But she is a 15 year-old girl who dreams from her heart for a romantic relationship. Now that she's in high school, she meets a cute (kind of short) boy named Haruka, and a big bad boy named Shindou and...

records.title: Da Capo II: Imaginary Future
records.original_title: D.C.II～ダ・カーポII イマジナリーフューチャー～
records.description: Due to family issues, Nanaka starts to stay in the Yoshino household, living together with Yoshiyuki and Sakura. In the same setting as the original D.C.II with a different story that revolves mainly around Nanaka and Koko.

records.title: Kakatte Kinasai!
records.description:
1. Kakatte Kinasai! (かかってきなさい!); Ribon Original 2001-02
2. Heart no Present (ハートのプレゼント); Ribon 2000-12
3. Ushiro no Shounen Daare (うしろの少年だあれ); Ribon 1998-nen Haru ni Bikkuri Dai Zoukangou
