Now, Jun lives at the home of their former gardener and attends a public school with the gardener's son Koutarou.  Unfortunately, Jun and Koutarou just can't seem to get along...

records.title: Shichigatsu no Mahoutsukai
records.description:
A collection of cute short stories that take place at a school that is divided into a sports section and a very studious section geared towards getting into college.

1) Wizard in July
2) The Prince Melancholy in November
3) Queen and Me in October
4) Gozen no Mori
5) March Lovers

records.title: Lamento: BEYOND THE VOID 4-koma Nightmare Festival
records.original_title: Lamento - BEYOND THE VOID 4コマ nightmare festival
records.description: A collection of 4-koma comics featuring the characters from the game Lamento - Beyond the Void

records.title: I want t hear your voice
records.description:
1-2) I Want to Hear Your Voice (Kimi no Koe ga Kikitai)
A famous singer is having issues with his voice and he may be unable to sing. He meets a young man at the hospital but the pretty guy is mute...

3) Castrato

4) Two Princes (Futari no Ouji)

records.title: Bamboo Blade B
records.original_title: バンブーブレードビー
records.description: Ookido Yuu is an extremely tall girl who just entered middle school. Because of her height everyone is trying to recruit her into their sports club, even though she is terrible at them. Her childhood friend, Ken-chan, who is still in Elementary school, keeps on telling her to join the Kendo club. But she hates Kendo, because she never had a single victory against him.

records.title: Kininaru Roommate
records.original_title: 気になるルームメイト
records.description: After having been dumped by his girlfriend Hazuki after he lied about his college acceptance in order to have sex with her, Suguru encounters a beautiful girl in the middle of the river, and ends up helping her find her broach. The next day, while looking for his uncle's boarding house, he finds out that the main floor of the boarding house encompasses a strip club, and that the girl he helped before, Urara, also lives in the building. Soon enough, they end up living in the same room, as roommates. Suguru's goal is to take a year off to study so that he can eventually get into Hazuki's college, but with so many beautiful women around him, how can he possibly concentrate?

records.title: I Want to be Myself
records.description:
1) I Want to be Myself
Ookawa Taketo is in love with his Biology sensei, Tsuruoka. After he confessed, Sensei refused to accept him because he was dumped once by a student before. Will Ookawa’s determination and his strong love convince Sensei?

2) I Want to Know More About You
Tsuruoka is very serious when it comes to Ookawa as both a boyfriend and a Teacher. When Tsuruoka happens to over hear a conversation between Iwase, Ookawa's homeroom teacher, and another teacher concerning Ookawa's future, he becomes more deeply troubled. With his growing concerned mixed with his own anxiety, how will he tell Ookawa?

3) Route 17
Runner Tsuji is confessed to by his kouhai, star athlete Tenranishi, but without waiting for an answer, Tenranishi tells him to forget about it and runs off!

4) Hope This Can Be Forever
Hiromi's cool exterior hides his growing feelings for Yutaka, but suppressing his emotions where his childish kouhai is concerned is getting more and more difficult. The day is coming when Hiromi won't be able to hold back anymore...

5) The Feeling of Love
Seiji always though a charming smile would get him out of trouble, so he grins idiotically all time. But classmate Inoue only wants to see Seiji smile for real.

6) The Four Seasons at the Toda Flower Shop
Florist Shougo has been alone since his wife Kana died five years ago. Well, almost alone, her annoying and cheerful nephew Takao is determined to stay close to Shougo, no matter what! Takao's love is definitely more than uncle/nephew, but what about Shougo's feelings?

7) Mint Candy
Miyahara's wedding is a reunion for former college classmates stoic Kuze and light-hearted Takeda. Even knowing how cool Kuze is, Takeda is still surprised at his nonchalance, since Takeda always thought that Kuze had a crush on Miyahara.

records.title: Love Hole Clinic
records.original_title: ラブホールクリニック

records.title: Doku Doku Ryouki Zukan
records.description:
Collection of erotic grotesque stories. They all contain an heavy dose of violence, mutilation, rape and cannibalism.

The stories are:

01. Flesh Colored Water
02. Material
03. Together With Peko
04. Comeback
05. Jill's Knife
06. Ego
07. Crybaby Sick
08. Three Bums
09. Disposable Toys

records.title: Kagakushitsu no Ouji
records.description:
1. Subete wa Ai no Shiwaza desu (全ては愛のしわざです, In the End, Love is Your Own Doing)
Inuzuka is known as the eccentric prince of the school's chemistry room. His classmates always stayed away from him because they see him as a weirdo. Although one day, class committee member, Akai, is requested by the teacher to "Please get along well" with Inuzuka. However, Inuzuka's interpretation of "Please get along well", turned out to be "Please go out with me" and hence begin the high school love comedy!

2. Kagakushitsu no Ouji (化学室の王子, Princes of Chemistry)
The continuation of Inuzuka's and Akai's relationship!

3. Mitsugetsukei Honey (蜜月系ハニー)
Who is this person that blankly states that he will have Takumi for "takeout"?

4. Toshishita no Otoko (年下の男, Younger Man)
Story of Miyabi from Mitsugetsukei Honey and Yui's younger brother, Jun.

5. Junsui yori mo Aimai na (純粋よりも曖昧な, More Impure than Pure)
Spoiled rich boy Kimihisa can never seem to tell his lover how he really feels. instead he's always arrogant and demanding to him. will he lose the one he loves because of it, or can he finally make his real feelings known?

6. Kawaii dake ja Dame! (可愛いだけじゃダメ！, I don't just want to be cute!)

records.title: Megane no Hito
records.description: Why is that whenever I touch her, my hands seem to be cold? Or is that she doesn't want me to touch her?

records.title: Tetsuzin
records.description:
Together with his robotic pet, atom, Sho Tobio travel from Japan to Dong Bei City in People Republic of China. tetsuzin-1His mother, Saeko, is a scientist graduated from MIT who is sign to reevaluate Japanese weapons left in China as the result of Japanese colonialism years ago. Some of those armors are producing dangerous gas. Moreover, the sentiment for Japanese is stabbed inside local people’s mind. It’s amazing how Saeko still manage to get her 10 year old son in that kind of area. Sho was born in Japan, grew up in America, and before he could spend time remembering Kanji at his school in Gunma, he now has to deal with new unfriendly environment. Atom is the only one he can talk to. That little robot has been accompanying for all these lonely days when her mother is so busy working.

One night Sho was having phone conversation with her grandma in Japan when the electricity black out. Suddenly Atom reacts into some transmission and run away. Sho is trying hard to catch him. When he finally gets his hand of his dog, they’re already in some kind of basement. Right in front of their eyes lays a gigantic robot.

records.title: Yoru no Douwa
records.description:
Seven touching short stories with a bit of a magical fairy tale quality about them.
A collection of Konno Kita's early oneshots; originally self-published and later collected in tankoubon format.

1) The Road Home: An old man reminisces about the past.
2) Garden: A sheltered princess experiences grief for the first time.
3) Beyer’s Waltz: A woman who's “getting on in years” makes a decision about her love life.
4) The House that Waits for Spring: A girl faces her future in the shadow of the irresponsible father she dearly loves.
5) Rattle: In an impossible land, an old man is reunited with his granddaughter.
6) The Man Who Sells Glasses: A magical glasses seller drops by a small town to sell his wares.
7) Light Source: One snowy night, a man meets a curious little girl.
8) Evening Fairy-Tales: A young man who professes to be a "cat lender" draws out long-forgotten memories in his clients.

records.title: Death Face
records.description:
Collection of erotic-grotesque stories. Contains rape, mutilation, degradation and usual guro subjects so be warned.

The stories are:

01. Cockroach
02. Night Of Chrysalis
03. Boxer
04. Ultra mariko
05. 4th Class: Biology
06. Material (in 3 chapters--last is Calling You)

records.title: Dragon Eyes
records.description: A dramatic action adventure about a wealthy young woman who ventures into a dangerous criminal world to find and get assistance from a mysterious man with a "Dragon Eye".

records.title: Koibito-tachi ga Furu Koi
records.description: A rich hotel tycoon purchases the injured Nichika with a large sum of money. He takes the trouble to treat the young boy’s heart and body kindly, but vehemently embraces him. The hotel mogul is very happy, but Nichika is insecure!?

records.title: Blue Diamond
records.description: Hiroki, who was just dumped by his girlfriend, suddenly encounters a tiny floating spaceship containing a large blue diamond. The little ship starts talking to him, and then (to make it easier to communicate) it borrows the form of a popular male idol singer it sees on a nearby tv screen! Hiroki's life is about to get very interesting...

records.title: Don't Show Such a Sweet Face
records.description:
One morning, Naoki, a new hire and a virgin, wakes up to find himself completely naked and next to him is a handsome man who is completely naked, too. That man is Takano, an intimidating manager who is in charge of training the newcomers! Takano gently asks Naoki, "Are you all right? Was last night too hard for you, a first-timer?"

Is this.... what losing my virginity is like?

(Source: Super BexBoy Comics, translated)

records.title: My Pet is a Salaryman
records.original_title: 僕のペットはサラリーマン
records.description:
1-3. Boku no Pet wa Salaryman (僕のペットはサラリーマン)
A boy is saved from being hit by a car by his beloved german shepherd dog, who is hit instead. The spirit of the dog, who loves his master very much, enters the body of the salaryman who was driving the car...

4. Ai Senshi (愛戦士)
5. Ai Kariudo (愛狩人)
6. oh!Yeah!!Z (oh!Yeah!!Z)
7. Bou Izu ♡ Ai (某伊豆♡愛)
8. Ai Tejinaji (愛 手品師)

records.title: Turning Point
records.description:
In the pursuit of his dream to become a successful writer, Sakuragi Keigo has become jaded and disillusioned. All he really wants any more is a good night's sleep, unburdened by the stress and pressure of his career. When he picks up a stranded Imamura Toshiki, a student looking for his own dream to follow, Sakuragi finds himself being inexplicably kind to the younger man. Why? Will Imamura be able to help Sakuragi sleep through the night?

(from Biblo Eros)

records.title: Tsuki no Hikari ni Terasarete
records.original_title: つきのひかりにてらされて
records.description:
A collection of short stories:

1. Tsuki no Hikari ni Terasarete (つきのひかりにてらされて)
2. Bokura no Shukumei (僕らの宿命; Our Destiny)
3. Gekkou Karyuudo (月光狩人; Moonlight Hunter)
4. Bokura wa Sore wo Gaman Dekinai (僕らはそれを我慢できない; Teach Me How to be Patient)
5. Hakuchuumu wa Nemuranai (白昼夢は眠らない)

records.title: Seiken no Blacksmith
records.original_title: 聖剣の刀鍛冶（ブラックスミス）
records.description: Once upon a time, there was a tragic war, in which the power of the devils was involved. After the war, the devils' power was banned and the world was restored to peace. Cecily Campbell is a knight, who has been looking for a blacksmith to repair her old sword given by her father. One day, she saw a man fighting with a ruffian who used the tabooed devil's power. The man defeated him with one blow of his weirdly shaped sword. The man turned out to be a blacksmith called Luke. The fateful encounter was the beginning of the adventure.

records.title: The Sacred Blacksmith
records.description: Once upon a time, there was a tragic war, in which the power of the devils was involved. After the war, the devils' power was banned and the world was restored to peace. Cecily Campbell is a knight, who has been looking for a blacksmith to repair her old sword given by her father. One day, she saw a man fighting with a ruffian who used the tabooed devil's power. The man defeated him with one blow of his weirdly shaped sword. The man turned out to be a blacksmith called Luke. The fateful encounter was the beginning of the adventure.

records.title: Otona no Kodomotachi
records.description:
A collection of several short stories:

1. Boys Be Awake!
2. Otona no Kodomo-tachi
3. Otona no Kodomo Miman
4. Sunao ni Naru Houhou
5. Plastic Cherry

records.title: Kanamemo
records.description: Nakamachi Kana is a junior high school girl. Her grandmother passed away and she was left all alone. She finds a newspaper carrier station and starts working as a live-in carrier. Her room has a hole in the wall. Other female workers living next doors come in through the hole and start a wild merrymaking.

records.title: Seitokai no Ichizon
records.description:
The members of the student council of Hekiyou Academy are chosen by a popularity vote. As a result, all the members are cute girls except for Sugizaki Ken, who studied hard to enter the council. This novel is about the endless chatters of the members, full of parodies from various other works such as "The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya", "Dragon Ball" etc.

The series was originally planned to be titled as "Hekiyou Academy Student Council's Minutes (碧陽学園生徒会議事録, Hekiyou Gakuen Seitokai Gijiroku), but because of the length, the title of the first volume "Seitokai no Ichizon" was chosen to refer to the whole series. It is also called "Seitokai Series" by some.

records.title: Fly High!
records.description: Meru Tachibana, 12 years old. She's just returned back to Tokyo after 7 years of training with her father, who thought she was a boy! Now Meru is stronger than most guys, and she's doing her best to make sure that people don't find out, or else her chances of making friends is ruined! However, a group of eighth graders seem insistant on making that impossible, as they break the rules and pick on the weak. Will Meru be able to stop them as the new student council president without appearing to be a "Monster From Melt King" as her mother has warned?

records.title: SF Special: Kenji Tsuruta Early Works Collection
records.original_title: SF名物 鶴田謙二初期作品集
records.description: Early works by Tsuruta

records.title: Loop Salad
records.description: Several vignettes featuring a young girl and her uncle on a series of fantastical adventures.

records.title: Sonoki ni Saseruna!
records.description: The continuing adventures of Hinata and Seshir.

records.title: Koi wa Jirazu
records.description: Popular guy Nakano discovers that his classmate, the scary tough guy Kusanagi, actually loves things like knitting, cooking, and sewing. Kusanagi begs him not to tell anyone, and a strange friendship begins...

records.title: Yomikiri Mono no...
records.description:
In the Yomikiri Mono no... (よみきりものの…) series:

1) Koomi Life
2) Warai no Sonozono
3) Hito Life
4) Yawarakakute Gu
5) Hokkoku (Hokugoku) Rakuen

records.title: Akuma de Omocha
records.description: Humorous set of short stories revolving around a pair of salarymen, one of whom likes to sexually harass the other in a comedic way...

records.title: Mf
records.description:
A set of short stories, including:
1 - a drunken game of cards leads to some unexpected results
2 - Shouji is in love with Miwa-chan who is in love with Shuuhei. A love triangle of childhood friends.
3 - 5 - Introverted Ritsu and extroverted Souta both play saxaphone in their school band. But Souta also plays jazz in some local clubs. One day he invites Ritsu to hear him play...

records.title: Teki Akuma Shirushiki
records.description:
My lovely doll is suppose to undergo a spectacular transformation when she climaxes, but I still haven't seen it yet! And it's driving me crazy!

(Source: HanaOto, translated)

Note: Sequel to Sweet Devil

records.title: Made in Harem
records.description: A girl who has recently become orphaned, is suddenly asked by a mysterious old woman to come work at a maid in her huge, palace-like house. There she will be serving several handsome young masters.

records.title: I Want Papa
records.description: Sequel to Mad Pa Pii

records.title: Vampire Beast
records.description: A young man named Hibiki encounters a mysterious man who soon becomes his lover. But the man is not normal...

records.title: Kimi ni, Meromero
records.description:
A collection of oneshots about unusual couples: including one that comes together through the uke's love of late-night flashing, crossdressing and lacy undergarments

• Motto Boku Wo

• Ureeru Don Quixoute
Hijiri and Kunihiro are in love and dating, but Hijiri is starting to worry that their relationship is just a sexual one. All of their dates end in the same way, with sex in public places! Maybe if Kunihiro was jealous Hijiro could find out how he really feels..
(Source: DokiDoki)

records.title: Kiss Shiyou Te wo Tsunagou
records.original_title: キスしよう手をつなごう
records.description: The complicated love relationships between a group of 20-something year-old students.

records.title: Go! Tenba Cheerleaders
records.original_title: ごてんばチアリーダーズ
records.description: The Cheerleading Club is trying to recruit the last remaining member of the Rooting Club. Expect an excess of school spirit and fanservice.

records.title: Oh! My Darling
records.description:
From SugarManga:

Shinpei is 8 years older than Hikaru and due to her Grandfather's health they got married but does Shinpei really love her or is it just fatherly love?

records.title: Nerima Daikon Brothers
records.description: The somewhat rough Hideki, former idol Mako, and cool host Ichiro live together on a stage in the middle of a daikon field. Their dream is to build a concert dome there to perform blues music to the masses, but they're just too poor to get anywhere.

records.title: Chizumi to Fujiomi-kun: Pastel Kibun
records.original_title: 千津美と藤臣君 パステル気分
records.description:
Chizumi, now a college student but still as clumsy as ever, continues to experience new feelings and situations. First, she becomes the target of a gang -- but even gang leaders have feelings. Next, she and Fujiomi begin tutoring and some romantic rivals pop up. Chizumi is like a child's pastel scribbles to Fujiomi's ink sketch, but as long as the two care for each other their relationship stays strong.

Also included is a short story about the couple before they met.

records.title: Hammer Session!
records.description:
Two prisoners managed to escape after the police truck carrying them crashed on the highway. One of them , Mr Sawazaki (?) is a gangster who has sent 10 opposite bosses to hospital. The other called "You" - our protagonist - is a con artist whose cheating profile has piled up to approximately 100 billion yen. Accidentally, "You" then becomes the new teacher for the nearby high school, under the new name Takeda Shindo, and according to a deal of "Hammer Session" with the headmaster.

The story is about a teacher who has a past record as a con-artist. It has its own unique taste, which makes it distinctive from other series about teachers, such as GTO and Gokusen.
.

records.title: Tenryu: The Dragon Cycle
records.description: Are they humans in dragon form, or dragons in human form? Can they keep their tempers long enough to find out? Two sword-packing brothers must find their father's killer and learn their true origin in war-torn ancient China. Two brothers search for revenge, treasure, and the secret of their powers.

records.title: Daylight: Asa ni Hikari no Kanmuri wo
records.description: Manga adaptation of the PC game Daylight - Asa ni Hikari no Kanmuri wo.

records.title: Doubt
records.description: Five men gathered in the mountains to conduct a survey. There, Misaki meets Yanagida, who looks like his missing lover Kousaka. But with no memories of the past, can Yanagida really be the man Misaki used to love!? A notice of personal change cutting the team down to four als arises the possibility of there being a spy! Plagued by doubts, who do these men truly love? And who is the real spy?

records.title: Sensitive Area
records.description:
If it’s with the boyfriend I love, it’s okay. But I want to secretly feel a woman’s sensitive place…

[Compilation Work] Sensitive Area / The Front Line of the Last Pure Love / Master Fascination Mission / Summer King / Petit Complex
(Source: Starry Heaven)

records.title: Chrome Shelled Regios: Secret Side
records.original_title: 鋼殻のレギオス シークレット・サイド
records.description:
In this school fantasy story set in the distant future, creatures contaminated by pollution have overtaken the land, forcing humanity to live in isolated mobile cities called Regios. One such city named Zuellni is a self-contained school in which freshman Layfon Alseif has just enrolled. Layfon reluctantly joins the 17th Martial Arts Studies Unit led by the third-year student Nina Antalk and embarks on a series of adventures.

The story is a reorganized version of the original novel. Layfon is the main character.

records.title: Tomorrow
records.description: Hamisaki Aya saw her boyfriend Yuu die in front of her, after he saved her from an oncoming car. Since then her life has been in limbo. She is unable to go to school or relate to her friends or family. One day in the hospital where she receives counseling, she is stuck in an elevator with a young girl, Nagisawa Nayu, who has not spoken since her family was killed in the Kobe earthquake. Now Nayu's only family is Nagisawa Issei, her cousin. He is a medical student working in the hospital where Aya receives treatment. As the story progresses, these three people, who have lost those they loved most in terrible accidents, learn how to start living again.

records.title: Shirokuro Tsukeru?
records.description:
Two kingdoms exist in the heavens, each with their own royal families. Despite being at war, a prince of the Black Country, Sakuya, is friends with a prince of the White Country, Rui, and his sister Mio. The three spend a lot of time together at a lake on neutral ground. One day, Mio frantically flew to their spot and called out to the boys, but was drawn into a strange portal and disappeared into darkness before saying anything. Left behind, Sakuya and Rui are still drawn to the location. Three years later, a girl dressed in foreign clothes who looked exactly like Mio fell out the sky. However, she claims to be a different person from the lower realm!?
(Source: shinkeikaku)

records.title: Hoshi no Furu Machi
records.description:
"The stars that don't shine in Tokyo surely do shine in a different town..."

Tsutsumi Koutarou, who couldn't be a senior at a college-oriented high school in Tokyo, moves into Himi City, Toyama Prefecture with his distant relatives and spends one school year there.

"I wouldn't be able to shine for the rest of my life..."

He's hurt, and depressed.
However, his encounter with a girl named Nagisa changes his "tomorrow" little by little.

Now, Hara Hidenori begins "the sweetest 'starting-over' love story in the world"...

records.title: Trouble Dogs
records.description: Shiina Kanako, voted the most beautiful girl in her high school, is a member of the school's gymnastics team.  Overhearing talk that the boy's soccer team was planning to harass her team during summer training, Shiina decides to ask a mysterious group on campus called "Trouble Dog" rumored to solve all sorts of clients' problems for money.  Through this she encounters three mysterious guys named Ryuu, Pochi, and Sabu.  Who are they really and what do they want her to do?

records.title: Yumemiru July Cat
records.description: A collection of short stories with a romantic theme.

records.title: Mahoutsukai-san Oshizuka ni!
records.original_title: 魔法使いさんおしずかに!
records.description: Follows the story of Sue, a young girl learning magic and not always getting it right.

records.title: Variety Morning
records.description: Follows the adventures of Yasumi Okazaki, a 13 year old who lives in a world of aliens, invisible people, talking animals, and general weirdness.

records.title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Kokoroiyashi-hen
records.original_title: ひぐらしのなく頃に 心癒し編
records.description:
Summer 1983...Hinamizawa is a tranquil village, but its inhabitants have been plagued by strange deaths and unexplained disappearances seemingly every year. Some say it's the terrifying curse of Hinamizawa's legendary deity, Oyashiro-sama, causing victims to be spirited away by monsters, but is this town harboring dark, horrying secrets even more sinister than any supersition or myth?

An epilogue to Matsuribayashi-hen where Rika and the others, including Hanyū, go on a summer vacation to heal their hearts, so to speak, after everything they have been through.

records.title: Strange Mansion
records.original_title: すとれんじマンション
records.description: Koyoki goes to Tokyo and move next door to the boy Shirohai that she liked in High school. When she went to visit, a girl greeted the door instead, Whom she thought was the boy's girlfriend or older sister turns out it was Shirohai Sempai. What happened? Shirohai confessed to the captain of the Oandan, but the captain turned him down...saying he's not interested in men, so Shirohai came back six month later with some changes and they have been living together since. He is hiding from his family, since his father will kill him if he finds out, he was raised to be the man of men so his family can't find out.

records.title: Kimi wa Boku no Taiyou
records.description:
A short one-shot about someone who is taken in from the cold by the only person to notice him, a young man named Taiyou.

Published in Mugen Anthology Vol. 12:Christmas Rose no Hatsukoi (2008-12-08)

records.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts
records.original_title: バカとテストと召喚獣
records.description:
The protagonist is a guy who is among the stupidest of the stupidest in the school. In this school, your grades can, under the supervision of teachers, take a virtual form to do combat! However, if you leave an examination half way, you get zero marks. A bright and cute girl, Mizuki Himeji, was having a high fever during the examination. Despite her potential to be the second highest scorer in the level, she obtained zero marks for having left due to her illness and is thus allocated to the worst class, class F.

Grades mean almost everything. For Class A, they have a smart-looking teacher, a plasma TV as big as the entire wall as their blackboard, personal laptops, personal air-cons, refrigerators, adjustable seats and all kinds of different appliances. Within the refrigerator, there are all kinds of drinks and snacks. Their ceiling is made of glass, the wall lets them put up high-class drawings and plants. As for Class F, the worst class...They have Japanese desks and seat paddings. Their blackboard is dirty and there is no chalk even! Someone complains that the leggings of his desk is broken, so the teacher asks "Didn't we distribute some glue to stick wood together? Glue it back yourself later." Another complains that wind is blowing in from the broken window. The teacher says "I got it. I will apply for plastic bags and invisible glue to fix it later." There are spider webs everywhere, not a patch of the wall is clean. A unique moldy smell spreads across the entire room, it must be from the old tatamis used to tile the floor. This is the status of class F.

The protagonist feels displeased at such an arrangement, and seeks help from his friends to try to make a change through summoning war!! And they devise all kinds of plans to try to beat the famous class A, intending to get class A's classroom and equipment if they win!!

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

records.title: Hidan no Aria
records.description:
Tokyo Butei High school--- It was a special school where armed detectives, also known as "Butei" are being brought up. Tohyama Kinji is a sophomore student who has the unique body which activates a "super mode" when it was stimulated by "something". He tries to hide it to others in order to live a peaceful life. But trouble came to find him when he became a victim of a bombing incident, where he met the Butei high "Assault" department elite, Aria H. Kanzaki.

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

records.title: PuiPui!
records.description: Living in the high school student dormitories is first year Araki Jin, who's archeologist parents have sent him a mysterious lamp that, once polished, causes the academy's idol Zadou Sierra to abruptly appear! What's more, she is dressed in a maid outfit! After appearing, her father arrives and explains that Sierra is a descendent of a lamp genie, and that a genie needs to grant their master’s wishes in order to grow up. However, as a novice genie, Sierra cannot use her magical powers in any strong ways, and so she lives with the weak-bodied Jin making alot of tumultuous noise. Thus begins the fantastic story of Sierra, the Ojou-sama turned novice genie, and her master Jin.

records.title: No Dog No Life
records.original_title: ノー・ドッグ　ノー・ライフ
records.description:
Contains 8 **bestiality** stories:  
  
1. Gon and I, and Several Other Things  
2. Moving On  
3. Same Dream Same Destination  
4. First Experience at 37 Degrees Celsius  
5. Bath Time  
6. The Contributor Under the Bridge  
7-8. No Dog No Life (1-2)  
9-11. Their Limit (1-3)  
  
Sidenote:  
This has no relation to No Game No Life(pub. 2012) other than similar names; this came out in 2004.

records.title: Coffee Jikan
records.description:
This is a series of short stories that all involve coffee in some way.

1. Whatever I want
2. Cappuccino Kid (カプチーノ・キッド)
3. Currant (すぐり)
4. Robot Detective (ロボット刑事)
5. KIKI The Pixy
6. Hate to See You Go
7. Late Night +1 (深夜+1)
8. Little Girl Blue (リトル・ガール・ブルー)
9. Where are you
10. Riding On The Waves Of Winter (冬の波乗り)
11. Giraffes (きりん)
12. CHOPPED TOMATO PUREE
13. The Tanaka Book Cafe (田中ブックカフェ)
14. Dreams (夢)
15. Lost In The Flood
16. The Lying Doctor (うそつき博士)
17. Any Day Now

records.title: School Mate
records.description:
A story about two young gravure models who have recently made their debut. One of the pair, named Aikawa Miku, is spirited blond that is proud of her gravure status and only all to eager to let any and all know about it. Along with her childhood friend Urushibara Satsuki, she seems intent on making her brother's life as hectic as possible, made all the more simple considering he doubles as the pair's homeroom teacher.

(Source: thevagrants.org)

records.title: Twinkle Star Nonnonzie
records.original_title: トゥインクルスターのんのんじー
records.description:
A science fiction story set in 2264 which follows the adventures of 18 year old Nonnonzie, a beautiful young archeologist. Humans have moved out among the stars, and Nonnonzie spends her time searching the galaxy for "star pieces" and items such as pudding. Nonnonzie really likes pudding.

The series is full of Takemoto's signature cute characters.

records.title: Teke Teke My Heart
records.description:
Nozomi Hayasaka is 25 years old, but looks like she's 15 (much to her chagrin). One day, will walking along the street during the day, she's stopped by a man asking why she isn't in school.

It turns out the man, Shigeru Yoshida, is currently a junior high school teacher. He also turns out to be one year younger than Nozomi and someone who looked up to her in school. The series follows them as they start dating and falling in love.

records.title: Arisa
records.description:
Tsubasa thinks that her pretty and popular twin sister, Arisa, has the perfect life. Everyone at school loves Arisa—unlike the hot-tempered Tsubasa, whose nickname is “The Demon Princess.” But when Arisa attempts suicide, Tsubasa learns that her seemingly perfect sister has been keeping some dark secrets. Now Tsubasa is going undercover at school—disguised as Arisa—in search of the truth. But will Arisa’s secrets shatter Tsubasa’s life too?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

records.title: Ai no Hyouteki
records.description: Because of his father’s job transfer, Sakura had to transfer schools. The person who was waiting there was someone who holds the title student president, a huge sadist “demon”! From the moment they met, Sakura had been locked on as his target of love, having his body stolen, rudely stole him entirely. On top of that, the demon Masaomi’s father is the president of Sakura’s father’s job… in other words there is no escape!!!

records.title: Aoi-chan Panic!
records.original_title: あおいちゃんパニック!
records.description: A story about a part alien girl, Aoi Hayakawa, who transfers into the school which Hiroshi Morimura goes to. She then becomes a love interest to him.

records.title: Peepo Choo
records.description:
In this first of three volumes meet Chicago youth Milton, who frequents his local comics shop to watch the latest episodes of Peepo Choo, an anime that’s as wildly popular as it is bizarre. Milton would like nothing more than to escape his dreary neighborhood and travel to Tokyo, where he’d wear his cosplay outfit until it totally fell apart.

Perhaps he will get to do just that.

Smart, sexy, and cruel, Smith’s Peepo Choo shoves a gleaming knife into a trans-Pacific romance and vandalizes the tired walls of manga.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

records.title: Graduation Eve
records.description:
Three oneshots:
1) Graduation Eve
2) Jinx
3) Manatsu Kakume

(Source: Mangafox.com)

records.title: Jigoku no Kisetsu: Gurolism Sengen
records.original_title: 地獄の季節 ―グロリズム宣言―
records.description:
A compilation of short stories by various ero-guro artists. Each artist contributed one story except Shintaro Kago who did two (one in full colour). Front cover is by Uziga Waita.

When All's Said And Done by Shintarou Kago (Shintaro Kago)
This Piece Of Meat Is Talking (Death pays all Debts) by Uziga Waita (Waita Uziga)
Overflowing Stomach by Horihone Saizou (Saizou Horihone)
Chrysalis by Masato Tsukimori
Rotten Bud by Mitsuka Hattori
The Last Disposal Spot by Tataiko Ochi
The Holes by Machino Henmaru (Henmaru Machino)
Shameless Ranger by (Mokkori Five) by Asuka Shiraishi
.M.D.K. (Mechanical Destructive Killcommand) by 華麗王女
Crowd of Shit-Sacks (Bunch of shit-bags) by Jun Hayami

records.title: Nemurenu Yoru wa Knock Shite
records.original_title: 眠れぬ夜はノックして
records.description: Meet Tominaga Komaki, a 20-year-old university student and landlady of an apartment. Meet Ichimatsu Kusuto, one of the hottest students from the University of Mikado who strives to avoid his stalker. When Kazuji meets Maki, his new landlady, will sparks fly between the two?

records.title: Boku no Kawaii Joushi-sama
records.original_title: 僕のかわいい上司さま
records.description: Ayumi Hayashi is dating his office director, Taeko Matsumoto. The series follows their romance.

records.title: The X Files
records.description:
Contains adaptations of various episodes of "The X Files" series created by Chris Carter.

Volume 1:
-File #00: Pilot
-File #07: Ice

Volume 2:
-File #2: Squeeze
-File #12: Beyond the Sea

Volume 3:
-File #11: Fire
-File #05: Shadows

records.title: Harikiri Sayo-chan
records.description: Sayo Ishino is a young office lady with very cheerful and energetic personality. The yonkoma series follows her as she pursues her object of affection, a fellow office worker who sits next to her.

records.title: Kami no Hidarite Akuma no Migite
records.description: The 6 books contains 5 horror stories related to a primary school kid named Sou. Sou has an ability to foresee supernatural events in his dream and even make changes that would eventually happen in the reality. The 5 stories are the Eroded Scissors, the Disappeared Rubber, the Tongue of the Spider Queen, the Black Picture-book and Shadow Dead. All of the scary stories are linked by his unique experience.

records.title: The Boss
records.description:
From ADV:
Woo Sang High is under attack! The entire student body is being terrorized by a duo of frightening bullies who have recently been released from a juvenile detention center. Guk Do and his muscle-headed sidekick, Chung Ki, are on a rampage and they have set their sights on Saang Tae, a brawny teenager with the courage of ten men. He alone will battle the fearsome duo, but there’s only room for a few at the top, and only one man can be The Boss.

records.title: Gadirok
records.description:
From ADV:
The Hwan-Woong dynasty is in turmoil. General Hae-Mo-Soo has taken control of most of the land. Prince Chi-Woo, ruler of the Hwan-Woong dynasty, is so severely depressed by the hardships he's suffered during the Revolution that he has become almost non-functional. It's in this state that the prince is discovered by Gat, a peasant and close friend of the prince. Gat rescues Ghi-Woo from General Hae-Mo-Soo's men, but the danger is not over yet. Though Hae-Mo-Soo and Shi-Woo both lay claim to power, there can be only one ruler of the land. Gat and Chi-Woo begin their journey together, enduring heartache and hardship as they seek to reclaim the prince's rightful place on the throne.

records.title: Star Ocean 2: Second Evolution
records.original_title: スターオーシャン2 セカンドエヴォリューション
records.description:
Based on the PSP remake of Star Ocean 2 (Rena's side of the game).

Rena is a girl living in Expel. From young, she has always believed strongly in the legend of the Warrior of Light and believed that one day he will appear before her.

Then one day, the Sorcery Globe fell upon the planet of Expel, causing chaos to the planet. One day, Rena met Claude when she was at the Shingo Forest, who had saved her from a monster with a weapon that shoots a dazzling light.

Rena had believed that Claude was the Warrior of Light in the legend, but Claude had denied it. Despite that, the both of them set off together towards Eluria, where the Sorcery Globe fell, in-order to investigate it, meeting new people and gaining new allies on the way.

records.title: Renjou Sparkle
records.description: Sawara Yume has been playing the violin for over 10 years now. She's not particularly good at it but she likes to play. Right before her debut in a violin duet, a student from her school tells her that she plays bad and that she should just give up. This doesn't stop Yume, actually, now she is even more determinate to do good at the school's violin duet concert. Her plans don't go so well as she ends up to play the duet with Seima, the boy that insulted her playing earlier. Despite they're differences the performance goes really well, but what will Yume do after Seima kisses her in front of everyone after the play?

records.title: Midori no Ou: Verdant Lord
records.description:
Set in the near future where Mother Nature has decided to fight back against all of the human encroachment.

It has your standard apocalyptic scenario, but we're right in the middle of the apocalypse actually happening, rather than the aftermath. Vines and foliage entangle cities, as large wooden mech-like creatures called Arethusa (named after one of the mythical Greek Hesperides that tended the gardens in a remote corner of the world) rampage through cities.

Our main character is Souma Shin, a punk kid out of Japan. We start off with him coming to visit his twin (?) brother Ken. All hell breaks loose as Shin finds a group of small kids being used for military purposes, and tries to save them in the confusion created by an Arethusa invading the compound.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

records.title: Father Complex
records.original_title: ファザーコンプレックス
records.description: Fukami Rei is making the switch from modeling to acting, and getting a part in a drama with his idol Agawa Ryuuji is a dream come true. But admiration for Ryuuji's acting isn't the only reason Rei wants to get closer to the older man...

records.title: Sono Te no Netsu wo Kasanete
records.description: Nagisa Takakage just opened a restaurant, and finds himself with a strange regular customer. All the chefs agree that Kouga Nagisa is a real looker, and nobody minds that he shows up to ask them questions at work. After Kouga gets himself drunk at the restaurant though, Nagisa is forced to take him home, and finds things heating up a bit.

records.title: Aka no Washupiel
records.description: Note: It was released as a stand alone in 1993 by Biblos, and ran in BexBoy Magazine. When Suguro moved to publisher Taiyou Tosho in 1999, she continued the story in their Craft line, and closed it up as part of the second Aka no Washupiel in 2000.

records.title: Maria the Virgin Witch
records.description:
As a war to determine the rightful ruler of medieval France ravages the land, it seems that the only hope for most, is protection from the heavens above through prayer. But deep in the forest outside of a small, bucolic village, the witch Maria will not stand idly by as men kill each other and commit horrendous acts in the name of God and glory. Using her powerful magic, she'll summon various beasts and demons—even going as far as using a succubus to seduce soldiers into submission under the veil of night—all to stop the needless slaughter. However, Maria's display of her magical might has drawn the ire of the Kingdom of Heaven and after the Archangel Michael puts an end to her meddling, he curses her to lose her powers if she ever gives up her virginity. Will she forgo the forbidden fruit of adulthood in order to bring an end to the merciless machine of war?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

records.title: Atagoul Monogatari
records.description: Atagoul Monogatari takes place in a fantasy world where humans and cats can talk to each other. The story revolves around the adventures of the protagonist, Hideyoshi, and his friends.

records.title: Tsundero
records.description:
1. Cute Succubus (キュ～っとさきゅばす); Comic Megastore 2008-08
2. Ai Scraper (あい すくれーぱー); Comic Megastore H 2008-05
3. Doppler Lesson; Comic Megastore 2008-10
4. Anekon (アネコン); Comic Megastore H 2008-03
5. Mune☆Hime (ムネ☆ヒメ); Comic Megastore H 2007-11
6, 10. Tsundero (ツンデロ); Comic Megastore H 2007-06, kakioroshi
7. Boku no Seito de Niizuma de (ボクの生徒で新妻で); Comic Megastore H 2007-07
8. Reika Shiki Akaten Kokufuku Jutsu (レイカ式赤点克服術); Comic Megastore H 2007-10
9. Kaichou no Bukatsudou (会長のブカツドウ); Comic Megastore H 2006-12

records.title: Cage of Thorns - Freedom in Miniature Garden
records.original_title: 荊の檻～箱庭の中の自由～
records.description:
Tsurugi met Katsuragi's father and Tsurugi is afraid senior Katsuragi might do something to the company he manages, Mishima Construction. But young Katsuragi thought Tsurugi wanted a break-up and told Tsurugi he would definitely protect him. Tsurugi always thought that their relationship is purely sexual, without any feelings involved. Now Tsurugi met with some troubles, will Katsuragi keep to his promise to protect him?

(from Attractive Fascinante)

records.title: Sugar wa Otoshigoro
records.description:
Hatanaka Keiko's an odd girl with odd aspirations(I mean, REALLY weird), but she tries her best to fit in with the other girls in her class... she still sucks at it, though.

One day, she meets Asami, a girl who's even more of an outcast than she is... but unlike Keiko, Asami's own "outsider" status doesn't seem to bother her in the slightest.

As they grow closer, what's going to happen to Keiko's standing among the other girls? And what about Asami's own issues?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

records.title: Ruby Doll
records.description:
The president of the huge family company DI-group is going to select his heir from among his four grandsons, that's why Ru Jin, Ru Ha, Ru Min and Ru Sung gathered together!! Of course, everyone has his own reasons to become the next president... So the survival game of this coveted seat in the executive suite is going to START!!

(Source: Esthétique)

records.title: Zetsubou no Uta
records.description:
Lolicon manga that deals with crazy insertions and enlargements of both sides, with dark and sadistic twists in the stories.

Included Stories:
1. Friends (フレンズ); Comic Moog 2005-12
2. Kaeri Michi (かえりみち, The Long Road Home); 2005-04
3. Aigan Doubutsu (Animal Companion)
4. Hakai Shoudou (破壊衝動, Destructive Impulses); 2006-12
5. Shoujo Mushi (少女蟲, Swarm of Virgins); 2007-04
6. Chiisana Shinryousho (小さな診療所); 2007-08
7. Shinryousho Mienai Owari (見えない終わり, Blind End); 2007-12
8. Yousei Sample (幼性サンプル, A Young Sample); 2008-04
9. Shinobi Shoujo (忍び少女, Ninja Maiden); 2008-08
10. Honnou no Mikata (本能の味方, Instinctive Ally); 2008-12

records.title: Close to You
records.description:
Kouzuki, who works for an underwear company, spent a drunken night with his co-worker, Maniwa. Since he doesn't want to destroy his friendship with Maniwa, he tries to keep what happened that night a secret. Unfortunately, Maniwa seems to already know...

(from Fantasy Shrine)

records.title: How to Flirt with Sensei
records.description:
"There's no way you can run away from me-- I MUST HAVE YOU!" said the super-egotistic ex-host Hisakawa as he carried a bouquet of roses, to the beautiful yet uptight sensei, Shindo Misaki!!

Under the masterful fingers of his pursuer, Misaki was assaulted by a powerful lust, which rendered him defenseless to Hisakawa's advances. Though in truth, it was Misaki's unconscious wanton responses that captured Hisakawa's heart!

(Source: Japanse publisher, translated)

records.title: Tales of Symphonia: Toki no Kagayaki
records.original_title: テイルズ・オブ・シンフォニア―久遠の輝き
records.description: Two worlds exist, both unaware of the existance of the other. In order for one world to flourish, the other will have to perish. On the perishing world, a Chosen one is sent on a journey to restore that world's mana by awakening the Spirits and becoming an angel. Colette Brunel, the Chosen of Sylvarant, sets out on her journey accompanied by her best friends Lloyd Irving and Genis Sage. As they travel further they meet more friends and even more enemies, while they learn more and more about the truth behind the World Regeneration.

records.title: Yuki no Kuni kara
records.description:
In order to be able to get into the University of her choice with a hundred percent passing rate, Fujino Yuki went into Private Suidou All-Girl Academy, a high school that boasts about the students’ marvelous achievements. Yet, there’s a secret to the school’s excellent results- good looking guys as their teachers! Without knowing about the secret and only having a pure intention of going into that high school, what would happen to Yuki’s fate…?!

From Ochibichan

records.title: Sukinandakedo
records.description:
With nervousness, Iijima Tadahito decided to confess to his close friend Nagano Naoki. To his bliss, Nagano agreed to go out with him. But when he realizes that their dating life doesn’t differ much from the normal friendship they had before, and Nagano’s expressionless face also stays unchanging, Iijima gets all the more distressed...

The book also contains several oneshots.

records.title: My Code Name Is Charmer
records.original_title: コードネームはチャーマー
records.description:
Naomi, Makoto, Yuji, and Kaede all have psychic powers of some sort and make up the Supernatural Phenomenon Research Group of their school. They battle the Zeyrey, terrible monsters invisible to most people’s eyes, out to suck the life-energy of humans.

(Source: Anime News Network)

records.title: Utahime Fight!
records.description:
Utahime Fight is a collection of three short stories, all of which are about magical, mysteriously attractive girls and they effect they have on the people around them.

In the first story, a girl and her two friends (one male, one female) are really magical fighters for something - probably love and justice.

The second story follows two girls who are magically drawn into the plot of a movie, in which a prince strives to save his mother and his land. After being threatened with their lives, they wake up in the library in school. They have a final scene in which they admit that they love each other and story ends.

The third story is about a magical creature that enchants a young man and brings love into his life. (description from http://okazu.blogspot.com/2005/03/obscure-yuri-manga_23.html)

records.title: Eien no Nohara
records.description:
Kazuhime is a novelist, and her younger brother, Nitaro, is a high school sophomore who runs the household. The Furuya family has been living without a pet since the death of their old dog Kaki, but now a puppy named Mikan has joined the family! However, Mikan is distrustful of humans, and Nitaro will have his hands full dealing with the new dog!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 9 extras. Winner of the 15th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shoujo category in 1991.

records.title: Fuyu no Hana
records.description:
The flower in Itadori will bloom in the summer, taking his life as it took his sister's but giving others longer lives, but how can he leave his childhood friend Rakka behind...?

(Source: Psycho Pandas)

records.title: Kazemakase: Tsukikage Ran
records.description: "Tsukikage Ran is comprised of thirteen self-contained stories. The series follows Ran into a new town, where she encounters some kind of wrongdoing. Every episode climaxes with a swordfight featuring the protagonist, sometimes aided by Meow's martial arts prowess." - Wikipedia

records.title: Shin Goumanism Sengen SPECIAL: Sensouron
records.original_title: 新ゴーマニズム宣言Special　戦争論
records.description:
Is it a book of liberation, that breaks the invisible chains that still binds Japan 53 years after the war? Or is it a book of taboos, that unrealistically celebrates the nightmare of war? What is the nature of war? What makes us a nation? What is the role of the individual?

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

records.title: Sousoukyoku Nightmare
records.description: The owner of Aries, a strange antique shop, is Baku, a mysterious boy. The costs for the mysterious items there are the guests' nightmares. This is a story of Aries, a shop where only people drown in their dreams can enter...

records.title: Shin Goumanism Sengen SPECIAL: Taiwan Ron
records.original_title: 新・ゴーマニズム宣言SPECIAL 台湾論
records.description:
In 2000, Taiwan's long-time one-party rule ended, and for the first time, democratic elections brought a change of government. This book, which chronicled the “national creation myth” through in-depth reporting, became a bestseller in Japan and Taiwan, but it also exposed latent taboos and caused an uproar, including bashing by the Chinese unificationists and the author banned from entering the country. In 2008, however, Taiwan reverted back to the KMT regime. Prioritizing short-term economic interests, the people face a potential collapse of national identity and rapid “Sinicization” of the country. So what is a nation? What is nationalism?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

records.title: Mama Loves the Poyo Poyo Zaurus
records.original_title: ママはぽよぽよザウルスがお好き
records.description: The "adventures" of a young mother and father as they deal with the joys and challenges of raising small children. The "poyopoyo" in the title is an onomatopoeia for the young children "toddling" around (or walking unsteadily). (from Wikipedia)

records.title: Koisuru Sayo-chan
records.description: Continuation of "Harikiri Sayo-chan", with more romantic antics in the office between "him" and Sayoko Ishino, with Yukari trying to steal away the heart of "him".

records.title: Daisougi
records.description:
A funeral is on and all the people with fetishes about funerals start searching for it.

1. Daisougi (大葬儀)
2. Daishuushuu (大蒐集)
3. Daishiren (大試練)
4. Daishuumatsu (大終末)
5. Daisuikyou (大酔狂)
6. Konno Shigure no Koufuku Naru Hibi (紺野しぐれの幸福なる日々)
7. Toumezuka Sensei no Yuuga na Tanoshimi (遠目塚先生の優雅な愉しみ)
8. Nishikawa Chieri to Yukai na Nakama (西川ちえりと愉快な仲間)
9. DISC

records.title: Hanazakari Kachou-sama
records.description: Minako Sakurai is an office manager who likes to deal with her stress by consuming alcohol.

records.title: Cherish
records.description: Seven romantic stories (in nine chapters) published in "Newtype" (one story) and "Comic Genki".

records.title: Youkoso Lodoss-tou he!
records.original_title: ようこそロードス島へ!
records.description: A parody of the "Record of Lodoss War" series, using super-deformed characters.

records.title: To Meet You
records.description:
Ryuu left his small town for a better life in Tokyo, but after four years he feels trapped in a job he doesn't like and a tiny apartment. When Tatsushima, an old friend from his home town, shows up out of the blue to take him home will Ryuu be willing to give up his boring life in the city?
(Source: Biblo Eros)

Chapter 6, Heaven's War, continues the story of Cry and Sig from Heaven's Love.

records.title: Teacher & Secret
records.description: Kaji's woken up from his nap hearing popular Tsunoda sensei getting hot and heavy with another guy! But it's his partner, the plain Aritou sensei that Kaji can't stop thinking about. Kaji's eyes are being opened as he finds that the needs and dark desires that can bind together lovers aren't always about love...

records.title: Tsuyoshi Shikkari Shinasai
records.original_title: ツヨシしっかりしなさい
records.description: Comedic slice of life series about Tsuyoshi, a high school student who has to deal with a very domineering mother and sisters.

records.title: Tsuyoshi Motto Shikkari Shinasai
records.original_title: ツヨシもっとしっかりしなさい
records.description: The further adventures of Tsuyoshi.

records.title: Lucky Star
records.description: Lucky Star is a collection of contemporary gay romance comics from Japan. From the urban jungle to the barbaric wilderness, the pursuit of love and acceptance are universal themes. The five stories included in the first volume explore family taboos, nomadic marauder lust, yuppie drama, and the meaning of love. Recommended for mature readers. (Source: diesel-ebooks)

records.title: Mori no Kuma-san
records.description: On a walk, a trio of rabbits encounter a frightful bear. This one-shot discusses the use of chemicals on animals.

records.title: Combination
records.description:
The police officer Shigemitsu Hashiba is a funny man. He never seems to take anything seriously. But this attitude is just a mask that prevents him from being truly known by others.

All this will change when he is assigned as a partner to Keiji Sasaki, a diligent and too serious rookie.

The two form a perfect combination and their goal is to arrest Mr Sawada.

records.title: Yamanko!
records.description: Though it was a bit strange, three people ended up meeting. One, who looks younger than her age and able to see the supernatural. Another who is possessed by a "Yamanko" which refers to "Yama no ko", or a mountain child. She was possessed due to her bloodline and due to the possession, she has superhuman abilities which she can call upon. Finally, an awkward person who enjoys writing poems.

records.title: ALEXANDRITE
records.description: This story is a spin-off of Minako Narita's Cipher, with Siva's friend Alex Levine as the main character. Ever since Alex was young, he has harbored a complex about his extremely pretty face. People are always comparing him to a girl, so to combat this image, he has thrown himself into practicing martial arts. One day, though, he is scouted by someone to become a fashion model, and thus begins Alex's tale of growth and romance!

records.title: Ristorante Paradiso
records.original_title: リストランテ・パラディーゾ
records.description:
At the age of 21, Nicoletta travels to Rome to find her mother, Olga, who abandoned her long ago. Nicoletta finds her at Casetta dell'Orso, a charming little restaurant owned by Olga's husband. The staff of bespectacled gentlemen welcomes Nicoletta warmly, but Olga's reception is not so pleasant. Olga has never told her husband that she ever had children--and he must never know.

In exchange for Nicoletta's playing "the daughter of an old friend," Olga offers Nicoletta a place to live and an apprenticeship at the restaurant. Nicoletta fits in well among the unique personalities at Casetta dell'Orso. She gets along particularly well with the kindly headwaiter, Claudio, a divorced man who, after years, has still never taken off his wedding ring. As Nicoletta's feelings for Claudio become complicated, she finds a sympathetic ear in Olga, leading the estranged pair to form a friendship neither expected. But as they grow closer, the pressure exerted by the secret they share becomes too much to bear.

(Source: VIZ Media)

records.title: Renai Houteishiki
records.description:
The one-year-younger, cry-baby, childhood friend, Kanade, suddenly took Meguru’s first kiss! Though he's grown taller a bit recently, and the girls made a big fuss and called him “the piano prince”, I will not be tricked. He's a pervert who steals another guy’s lips! With additional pages, the perfect version is now on sale.

This manga skips a few years ahead of the ending of Kusatta Kyoushi no Houteishiki... Now it's time for the kids to shine! It features all of our favorite couples from Kusatta plus some new ones!

Note: The first chapter was originally released as chapter 4 in volume 2 of Not Ready!? Sensei.

records.title: Yukei Seikyo Kukla
records.description: A Japanese boy moves to a town in Russia after being adopted by his father ex-girlfriend, known there as "the lady of the Mountain". But who is this woman? What powers is she hiding?

records.title: Inferior ♂
records.description:
Noah is told by his mother that he actually has a twin brother who he had been separated from at birth because of a sickness.

Noah is excited at the prospect of meeting his twin brother, but why, when he goes to see him, is there a girl standing there?

records.title: Go Ahead
records.description:
Hungry for a teacher and student relationship? Nope, it's not about love or romance. It's all about sport! Find out what happens if both the teacher and student, who have nothing in common and hate each other in the beginning, are connected with hockey as their life.

Note: Includes the one-shot "Kami no Bannin"

records.title: My First Devil
records.description: In the spring of Kyoko's first year in high school, Eiko, a girl like a sister to her, returns with her younger brother, Jiro. The return isn't that big of a deal, but Jiro has it in his head that he wants to operate on Kyoko! And, what's even more, the two of them are actually from an organization bent on destroying world peace! As if high school didn't have enough problems already, now she has to deal with these two living with her.

records.title: Canaria Child
records.description: Kayuu, a doll-maker who was murdered six years ago made living dolls at the request of clients. Mitsuki, his daughter who is still finding out the mystery to her father, together with her favorite student Yue, are faced with countless ordeals. What is Kayuu's hidden secret?

records.title: Gente
records.description:
Buona sera! Welcome to Casetta dell’Orso, a quaint little restaurant in the heart of Rome. The food’s delicious, but the handsome staff of bespectacled gentlemen is the real draw. Follow these dashing men home and witness their romances, heartaches, hopes and dreams in this delightfully whimsical continuation of Natsume Ono’s beloved Ristorante Paradiso.

Go back to the beginning, when the owner Lorenzo was just opening Casetta dell’Orso. His wife Olga’s particular preference for a certain bartender inspires Lorenzo to hire an entire staff of gentlemen in glasses. Watch the cranky-but-kind Luciano juggle babysitting duty and the advances of an amorous customer. Witness handsome playboy Vito meet a healthy young college student who will eventually become his wife. All this and more awaits you, just beyond that discreet restaurant door…

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

records.title: Nikukai 16-nen
records.description: Story about a 16 year old girl who decides to meet a customer she serves on sex phone calls.

records.title: Ii Shi Tabidachi
records.description: A girl decides to commit suicide by jumping off a roof. As she falls down she reflects on her life.

records.title: Utsukushiki Kussetsu
records.description: Various erotic grotesque stories by Jun Hayami. This is certainly not for everyone and contains heavy doses of explicit pictures of masochism and sadism as well as some other fetishes. Contains one Yaoi story.

records.title: Watashi no Yona Minikui Musume
records.description: A father keeps his daughter closed in a small apartment to use her as an sexual object.

records.title: Hentai Shounen: Jun no Koufuku na Hibi
records.original_title: 変態少年―純の幸福な日々
records.description: Very explicit erotic grotesque manga. Contains material that is definitely not suitable for anyone outside of this genre.

records.title: Love Letter from Kanata
records.original_title: ラブレターフロム彼方
records.description: An rather unusual one shot from Jun Hayami. Unlike most of his works this one has supernatural elements and actually has some kind of point compared to most of his stories that center around human fetishes.

records.title: Pokemon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
records.original_title: ミュウと波導の勇者ルカリオ
records.description:
In the town of Lohta, a festival is thrown praising "Aaron the Wave Leader Hero" who, according to the legend passed down through the town's generations, stopped a war centuries ago by using the power of "the Tree of the World's Origin." Satoshi and Pikachu participate in a battle to decide this year's hero and after their victory, they are chosen as the "Wave Leader Hero." A grand dance party is held in the castle to celebrate the victor, but suddenly the phantom Pokemon Mew appears and takes Pikachu. Soon afterwards, the Wave Leader Pokemon "Lucario" is freed from his centuries-long seal and meets Satoshi. Satoshi must solve the various mysteries of where Pikachu is, what Mew's after, what the secret of the legend of the Wave Leader is and how it ties in with Lucario's hidden past as he makes his way to "the Tree of the World's Origin" with Lucario.

(Source: Anime News Network)

records.title: Haikei, Nanashi-sama
records.description: Terao Chigusa has always loved a certain book called "Dear, Mr. Nameless." Plus, she has a very timid personality, so much so that she gets REALLY scared when confronted by Takaya Tooru. However, one day, she ends up living the same situation as her beloved book!? How will she react!?

records.title: Beshari Gurashi
records.description:
A story about a stand-up comedian to-be.

The manga's story centers around Agatsuma Keisuke, a high school student with a great sense of comedy. A student named Tsujimoto Jun transfers to his school. Both share ideas and form a plan to make a stand-up comedian duo. They aim to become pro together, despite the many hardships they will face.

(Source: Anime News Network)

records.title: Koisuru Heart ga No to Iu
records.original_title: 恋するハートがＮＯという
records.description: Sawa is class president. Her teacher asks her to persuade Tatsuki, who always skips school, to actually attend classes. Tatsuki tells her that he will go to school only if she kisses him.

records.title: Ashita, Anata ga Mezame tara
records.original_title: 明日、アナタが目覚めたら
records.description: Unexpectedly, Kei will be moving to a new city because her father has been transferred to another place by his company. She rushes to tell her boyfriend that she will be moving very soon only to find him sleeping with another girl. She is shocked and upset and gets drunk and lost in her new city but a handsome stranger takes her. What will happen now...?

records.title: Kanojo wa Uso wo Aishisugiteru
records.original_title: カノジョは嘘を愛しすぎてる
records.description: Ogasawara Aki (age 25) is the reclusive, idealistic composer of the popular band Crude Play. Discontented with his life and with no drive to succeed, he meets Riko, the 16-year-old grocer's daughter in a band consisting of her childhood friends, and asks her to be his girlfriend on a whim. Riko, young and innocent, agrees immediately, but worries about her new boyfriend, whom she suspects has just broken up with a woman he cared very much for.

records.title: Love & Tears
records.description: Collection of sentimental love stories.

records.title: Sensei to Watashi
records.description: Yoshino Haruka, 16 years old, had to substitute for her older sister at an arranged date and ends up falling in love with Kunihiro-san... To discover the day after that he is her new high school homeroom teacher! How are the two of them going to deal with this forbidden relationship?

records.title: Darling Only You!
records.original_title: ダーリンオンリーユー！
records.description:
Yuzuki has a crush for her super kind and cool brother, but she has her heart broken when he brings his girlfriend home one day. The next day, by chance, she bumps into a guy who looks exactly like her brother! What is this feeling that she has for him? Is it just because he looks like her brother, or is it...?
(from Divine Sanctuary)

records.title: F.O.X II
records.description: The story picks up where the first story (F.O.X) left off. If you have not read the first series, you may not want to read this yet as it will have spoilers.

records.title: Sabu to Ichi Torimono Hikae
records.description:
The series follows the adventures of Sabu, a young Edo bakufu investigator traveling with the blind master swordsman Ichi. In their travels, they assist the common people in solving mysteries and righting wrongs (usually committed by bandits or corrupt officials). Sabu is engaged to Midori, the daughter of his boss, who works as a police officer for the Tokugawa shogunate.

(Source: Wikipedia)

records.title: Life☆Switch
records.description:
Will was an infamous, powerful bandit leader until an old woman’s curse turned him into a small, fluffy dog. In an instant, Will lost all his influence, money, and comrades--except one. His bodyguard Sefa stayed behind. Now the two travel the world, searching for a way to remove the curse. At least, that's what Sefa would like the boss to believe. Sefa is just enjoying the ride and he won't let anything threaten his place at the boss's side.

(Source: the manga habit blog)

records.title: Raspberry Field no Majo
records.original_title: ラズベリーフィールドの魔女
records.description: Alice attends an all girls' academy where all the students are required to live in the dorms. One day, in the dead of the night, she meets a boy--a devil who lives on secrets. Alice carelessly makes a contract with the boy and becomes a witch. Now, she will have to gather secrets for her master...!

records.title: Tokyo Ghost Trip
records.original_title: 東京ゴースト・トリップ
records.description:
The Inui family came from a long history, about 300 years back. Inui Souwa and Inui Setsu are two cousins who are staying together. They go to school like any other high schoolers do but they are different. Setsu is a gambler and he is a priest who can summon any spirit or ghost. Souwa, on the other hand, doesn't believe in any supernatural phenomenon or spirits, etc. because they are not scientifically proven. He also refuses to inherit his family business even though he actually acts as a medium for spirits to possess.

When Souwa's mother went travelling and did not pay the tax, both the cousins had to work it off to earn the huge amount of money. Of course, they have nothing but their family business to rely on. But will they make a good pair when all Souwa believes is that they are actually cheating the customers? What about Setsu with the "yin yang eye" who is extreme and dominating?

records.title: Sono Hitomi ni Utsuru Mono
records.description:
“Orangutans live alone in the forest, as if they cherish solitude.”

Ikeuchi Naoki is a young, enthusiastic high school biology teacher. Despite his inexperience, Ikeuchi wants to help and encourage his students, but he’s mostly ignored and looked down upon by them. One particular student catches his attention. The quiet Souga Takashi has some scary rumors floating around about how he was previously suspended for a violent incident. While trying to comprehend how the quiet Souga could be so violent, Ikeuchi comes across Souga’s future goals survey. It merely states “I want to become an orangutan.”

(Source: shinkeikaku)

records.title: Change
records.description:
A collection of short stories:

1. Change
2. Kitto Shiawase ni Naru Tame ni
3. Sukikamoshirenai
4. One Day
5. Kitto Shiawase ni Naru Tame ni Side B

records.title: Tashou Naritomo Higenjitsutekina Seikatsu
records.original_title: 多少なりとも非現実的な生活 - 川原未夜短編集
records.description:
Contains several stories:

Tashou Naritomo Higenjitsutekina Seikatsu
Trouble Scoop
Badminton wo Shiyou!!
Aru hi Suioukoukou no Ichi Nichi

records.title: Youto Chinkonka: Tokyo Requiem
records.original_title: 妖都鎮魂歌　トーキョーレクイエム
records.description: Spin-off story based on the Playstation game "Tokyo Majin Gakuen Kenpuchou" about one of the game's most popular characters, Kureha Mibu.

records.title: Romance: Itoshiku Tsumetai Kimi
records.original_title: ロマンセ 愛しく冷たい君
records.description:
Large compilation work containing:

The Romance series
Mijyukuna Tsubame to Emerarudo
Anata no Negai Watashi no Omoi
Sore wa Tenshi no Herikutsu
Watashi wo Hanazono e Tsuretette
Itoshiku Tsumetai Kimi
Yuuutsuna 5 Gatsu no Bara
Mathias
Kitto Ravian Rose

records.title: Utsushimi no Hana
records.description:
When he was a child, Tasuna’s father told him to seek his old apprentice if Tasuna ever desired to learn his father’s metal engraving craft. However, Tasuna was later sold to a noble and sexually abused. Desperate and with nothing to lose, Tasuna flees deep into the mountains in search of the old apprentice. Exhausted, Tasuna collapses and later awakens in a cave with a strange man named Azeri. Tasuna soon realizes Azeri is the man he’s searching for and begs to become his apprentice.

(Source: shinkeikaku)

records.title: Teacher's Pet
records.description:
Yura sensei who is happily in love with Kyousuke gets a confession of the rather violent variety from his student Kusaka. Kusaka insists that he is the one who loves sensei the most.
(Source: Geisha_X)

records.title: Fool for the City
records.original_title: フール・フォー・ザ・シティ
records.description: Fool for the City was the one of the early works of Nagano. It first appeared in NewType Magazine as a monthly feature later to be compiled into one volume in 1987. The main premise revolves around F.U. Rogner putting the rock band, Super Nova together.

records.title: Zippin' Hoppin' Slammin' Our Love
records.description: Masaki is a teenage senior high school student, whose boyfriend is 8 years older and his homeroom teacher, Tokuyama-sensei. As teacher and pupil, of course they need to keep it a secret, but both heart and body are carried away in this dangerous relationship because it's a passionate and erotic love!

records.title: Seikesshou Albatross
records.description: One day, junior high-schooler Yuuki helps a girl from another class, a weird girl known throughout the school as the "Trash Girl." Because of this selfless act, Yuuki's life undergoes a dramatic change!

records.title: Di Gi Charat Theater: Dejiko's Adventure
records.original_title: Di Gi Charatでじこ★あどべんちゃー
records.description: Dejiko's caused plenty of trouble with her Laser Eye Beam, but this time she's gone too far! In an attempt to teach Rabi~en~Rose a lesson, Dejiko shoots her Laser Eye Beam, but crushes the popular Gamers store too! With the Manager fainting of shock and the store in ruins, Dejiko, Puchiko, and Rabi~en~Rose must go find the "secret treasure od prosperity" to rebuilt Gamers! (Source: Broccoli Books)

records.title: Opera-za no Kaijin
records.description: Based on Gaston Leroux's "The Phantom of the Opera".

records.title: Nononono
records.description:
Nonomiya Yuuta, a Skii Jumper aiming for Olympic Gold, bursts onto stage with his exceptional skills. However, his biggest problem is that he is not really a "HE"... This Yuuta is actually Nonomiya Yuuta's twin sister, Nonomiya Nono... And with Women's Skii Jump not being an Olympic catagory, hiding her true identity is the only way for her to achieve the dreams of her father and brother.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

records.title: Wolf Guy: Ookami no Monshou
records.description:
Akira Inugami just transfered into his new school. The principal and teachers fear what may happen because Inugami was placed in the same homeroom as the school's biggest problem and gang leader.

His homeroom teacher Aoshika is going out of her mind trying to figure out what happened the night before, where she could have sworn she saw this same Inugami beaten alive and then hit by a car by a large group of thugs in a park. But somehow, Inugami, who denys everything, of course, is alive and without a scratch attending his first day at his new school.

What the teacher Aoshika did not witness was a crazy werewolf-like beast destroy the thugs that attacked Inugami in the park.

(Source: MangaTraders)

records.title: Kedamono Company
records.description: Crazy humans, bizarre half-human half-animal hybrids, and anthropomorphic animals populate this parody of office life.

records.title: Kin no Angel
records.description:
Recently orphaned school girl Kogane discovers that she has been set up in an arranged marriage with a very wealthy family. The marriage ties in to a very large inheritance. The three sons of the family have very different personalities. Can Kogane actually marry one of them?

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

records.title: Ar Tonelico
records.description: A mysterious disease is spreading amongst the reyvateils causing them to go berserk, the key to stopping them lies in the hands of Espada reid, the only problem is he hates reyvateils, will he be able to stop the reveris illness?

records.title: Yuushi Tessen no Koi
records.description: With the blessing of the wedding bells, Heiji has to bury his feeling to give wishes to Kou senpai and his sister. The love Heiji and Kou had during high school was so pure and innocent until Kou requested a break up. After they met again, everything went wild. The bridegroom and the brother-in-law scandalous meeting in the resting room, what will become of them? Includes 4 other cute and sweet one-shots of friends.

records.title: Daddy! Arisawa Family
records.description:
At the young age of 30, Arisawa Riku was already an obstinate father. But did being raised strictly send his high school-aged son, Tomoki, down the path of homosexuality?! “I forbid it, Tomoki!” However, Tomoki and Naoya-sempai will fight for the sake of their love! This theatrical romance takes place in the noisy living room of the Arisawa household.
(from Blissful Sin)

records.title: Mahoutsukai Sally
records.description: Sally wants to visit the human world. She is given permission, but she has to keep her magical abilities secret. She attends school and makes friends with whom she has a lot of fun.

records.title: 9to5 Love×Mission
records.description:
Violence x romance, thriller x romance, suspense x romance!

After graduating from the National Police Academy with excellent grades, Yoshiki Gotou (a young perfectionist) is partnered with a senior detective named Shinobu Kujo. Despite having a brilliant arrest record, Shinobu is willful and abrasive, with a habit of refusing to handle cases "by the book". As the pair start to investigate serious crimes together, their relationship begins to strengthen. Although very different people, when Yoshiki and Shinobu work together, things have a habit of getting intense...

records.title: Chat Noir no Shippo
records.original_title: シャ・ノワールのしっぽ
records.description:
Source: Shogakukan Website
Translation: Mari (from Aerandria)

Three sisters inherit their deceased mother's French restaurant "Chat Noir". But their mother's death isn't the only disaster that happened in that restaurant - for example, there's a thief who comes all the time, but never steals anything. Then one day, a man helped them chase out a client who was picking a fight. They let him lodge in their house as a token of gratitude, but he is a mysterious man with unclear past who never talks much about anything..!?

Contents:
Chat Noir no shippo
Breath of the crescent moon
Gemini

records.title: Gongjunimgwa Geondalnim
records.description: Who am I? I'm Gi-ryum, a tall, handsome bachelor, and the coolest guy in the country who even makes Yon-sama cry at my beauty. One day, I received classified info that the princess enrolling in a regular high school. Huhuhu. Can I snag the princess with my irresistible beauty?! I will be the king's new son-in-law!

records.title: Nousatsu Beat de Utawasete
records.original_title: 悩殺ビートで歌わせて
records.description:
A collection of five short stories, including one that is related to the author's previous work, "Nosatsu Rock Shounen".

1. Boku no Himitsu Kimi no Koe (僕の秘密　君の声)
2. Junai Sadism (純愛サディズム)
3. Sakuranbo Doumei (さくらんぼ同盟)
4. Robokare (ロボカレ)
5. Taiyou to Natsuyasumi (太陽と夏休み)

records.title: Gokuaku no Hana - Hokuto no Ken: Jagi Gaiden
records.original_title: 極悪ノ華 北斗の拳 ジャギ外伝
records.description:
A deeper look at the childhood and history of Jagi, one of the four Hokuto brothers, and an important villain in the original Hokuto no Ken manga.

Includes the one-shot: Hokuto No Ken - Ryuken Gaiden
An alternate version explaining the choosing of Ryuuken's successor and the nuclear apocalypse in the Hokuto No Ken universe.

records.title: Bihada Ichizoku
records.description:
There is a World Beautiful-Skin Competition (WBC) to which the 3 billion woman of the world aspire to win. Carrying on the 300-year legacy of the competition are twin Bihada sisters, Sara and Saki.

(Source: Anime News Network)

records.title: Doraemon's Long Tales
records.description: "Doraemon" is a series about a robotic cat named Doraemon, who travels back in time from the 22nd century to help a schoolboy named Nobita Nobi. Aside from the normal manga books, their great adventures to different places are specially described in Doraemon Long Stories books.

records.title: Bara no Kusari
records.description: When I was only 8 years old, I was attracted to Hagane, who was accepted into our house as the son of a servant. But is duty the only reason why Hagane listens to what I say...? I can’t understand how you feel because invisible chains bind you...

records.title: Gyakkyou Nine
records.description:
Persistent mediocrity hasn't dissuaded Fukutsu Toshi, captain of a lame high school baseball team, from his love of the game. But when the principal, dissatisfied with their losing performances, threatens to take away their playing field, Toshis is forced into action to turn things around with all out efforts. But facing him at every turn is endless adversity. Nothing is ever easy for him, but luckily, Toshi has the determination to beat it all.

(Source: MangaNews)

records.title: Bokutachi Otokonoko
records.description:
It's about two best friends, Tamio and Takashi. The development of a friendship to something more as they grow up.

Living his life in rural Japan, Tamio is immediately intrigued by Takashi, the blond haired city boy who transfers into his elementary school. But Takashi is actually half Japanese, and despite his appearance he doesn't even know English and loves eating Japanese food even Tamio can't abide.

Tamio and Takashi become friends, and despite his perplexity with Takashi's foreign appearance, Tamio quickly develops a strong attachment to the other boy. Tamio earnestly hopes that he and Takashi can stay friends forever. But Takashi remains dissatisfied with life out in the boonies, insisting that someday he's going to leave all this behind.
